Job Title: Organisational Change Management (OCM) - Sr Analyst OCM

Location: India

Who we are:

Unisys is a global information technology company that builds high-performance, security-centric solutions for the most digitally demanding businesses and governments on Earth. Unisys’ offerings include security software and services; digital transformation and workplace services; industry applications and services; and innovative software operating environments for high-intensity enterprise computing. Unisys builds better outcomes securely for its clients across the Government, Financial Services and Commercial markets. For more information, visit www.unisys.com .

Our Vision: Enhancing people’s lives through secure, reliable advanced technology.

Our Core Beliefs:

  • Curiosity: We embrace the unknown and continuous learning.
  • Creativity: We look past routine ways of doing things.
  • Client-Centricity: Our clients’ success is our success.
    • Integrity: We act ethically and honestly.

The Organisational Change Management (OCM) Senior Analyst plays a key role in designing, leading, and delivering organisational change initiatives that enable leaders, teams, and organisations to successfully adopt changes across business processes, systems, technology, and operating models. Working as a trusted member of the Unisys Organisational Change Management (OCM) team, this role partners closely with OCM Managers, project leadership, and senior stakeholders to drive measurable adoption outcomes.

The Senior OCM Analyst brings strong hands‑on experience, sound judgment, and methodological discipline to change delivery—owning workstreams end‑to‑end, coaching junior team members, and ensuring change activities are aligned to business outcomes, risk management, and benefits realisation.

Key Responsibilities

Change Strategy & Delivery

  • Lead the design and execution of OCM activities aligned to project objectives, business outcomes, and stakeholder needs.
  • Conduct and interpret change impact, readiness, and risk assessments at individual, team, and organisational levels.
  • Develop and tailor integrated change strategies, including communications, engagement, training, and resistance management plans.
  • Proactively identify change risks and adoption barriers; design mitigation strategies to address resistance and capability gaps.
  • Track, analyse, and report on adoption metrics, behavioural indicators, and change effectiveness to inform decision‑making.
  • Contribute to sustainment planning to embed change into business‑as‑usual operations.
  • Translate complex transformation initiatives into clear, actionable messages for diverse audiences.

Communication & Engagement

  • Lead the development of high‑impact, audience‑specific communications (executive briefings, change narratives, FAQs, campaigns).
  • Create multimedia and digital collateral (videos, infographics, intranet content) to drive awareness and engagement.
  • Ensure messaging is consistent, timely, and aligned with overall program governance and brand standards.

Training & Learning Support

  • Lead training needs analysis and learning strategy development aligned to role‑based capability requirements.
  • Design and review training materials, learning journeys, and reinforcement mechanisms.
  • Support and co‑facilitate training sessions for frontline staff, leaders, and executives as required.
  • Ensure training effectiveness is measured and iterated based on feedback and adoption outcomes.

Collaboration & Project Support

  • Work autonomously while aligning closely with OCM Managers, Program Leads, and delivery partners.
  • Facilitate workshops, feedback sessions, and stakeholder briefings to gather insights and refine approaches.
  • Contribute to OCM practice development, standards, templates, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Support governance activities including status reporting, risk escalation, and executive updates.

Required Skills & Capabilities

  • Strong written, verbal, and visual communication skills in English; additional languages (e.g., German, Dutch, other European languages) are an advantage.
  • Proven ability to design and deliver end‑to‑end change management activities across complex initiatives.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and facilitation skills, including experience working with senior leaders.
  • Ability to synthesise complex information and data into clear insights and practical recommendations.
  • Solid working knowledge of change management methodologies (e.g., Prosci / ADKAR, CMBoK) and their practical application.
  • Creative mindset with interest in using design tools (e.g., Adobe Creative Cloud or similar) for basic graphic or video editing.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools (PowerPoint, Word, Excel, SharePoint).
  • High level of organisation, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Proactive, adaptable, and comfortable operating in fast‑paced, matrixed environments.

Preferred / Desirable Skills

  • Experience supporting large‑scale digital transformation, system implementations, or operating model changes.
  • Background in Business Process Improvement, Knowledge Management, Learning & Development, or Instructional Design.
  • Familiarity with reporting and dashboard tools (e.g., Power BI, ServiceNow, SharePoint analytics).
  • Experience leveraging AI‑assisted tools (e.g., Copilot, ChatGPT) to enhance communications, analysis, or engagement.
  • Exposure to regulated, government, health, or enterprise environments.
  • Experience contributing to OCM practice maturity, tooling, or capability uplift initiatives.

#LI-RB1

You will be successful in this role if you have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Business, Psychology, Organisational Development, Human Resources, or a related field.
  • 4 years of relevant experience in Organisational Change Management, transformation, or related roles.
  • Prosci or equivalent change management certification (or progress toward certification) preferred.
  • Equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered.

description_html:
Sandvik’s business concept is based on innovation, technology leadership and close, long-term customer relationships. In line with our vision and values, our ambition is always to set the industry standard in the areas in which we operate. Today, new technology paves the way for exciting new products and methods, as well as for new business opportunities within manufacturing. We are entering the industries of additive as well as digital manufacturing to even more strengthen our leading position.

With 43,000 employees in more than 160 countries, it’s needless to say that our team of employees comes from a wide range of cultural, geographical and professional backgrounds. To continue building a strong workforce, we’re always on the lookout for new talent. We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Global Rewards Operations Analyst to join the Global Rewards Operations team. This role reports to the Head of Global Rewards Operations. This position will be based in Pune.

Scope:

This role plays a critical part in strengthening centralized rewards operations by supporting bonus/STI calculations, pay equity compliance, and data-driven reward processes.

The role will also contribute to AI-enabled transformation initiatives and incentive program administration, ensuring scalable, accurate, and compliant global rewards processes while supporting regional C&B teams

Key Performance Areas:

  • Support Annual processes such as Merit, Bonus, market benchmarking, and bonus calculations
  • Deliver data analytics and reporting, ensuring accuracy and consistency across regions
  • Contribute to AI and automation initiatives, including support for AI tools and process improvements
  • Support incentive program administration and act as backup for key processes
  • Collaborate with regional C&B, payroll, HRIM, and external vendors for seamless operations
  • This role is part of a growing centralized Global Rewards Operations capability

Required Skills & Qualification:

  • Strong Excel and data management skills (advanced level required)
  • Ability to manage large datasets and complex calculations
  • Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail
  • Experience working in a global, matrix organization
  • Ability to work independently and manage cross-country coordination
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and eager to contribute to future growth initiatives.
  • 4–6 years of experience in HR analytics, compensation, or payroll in an MNC environment
  • University degree in HR, Finance, Business, or related field

We are genuinely interested in your personal qualities, as well as in your interest and ability to lead and motivate people in a virtual and global organization. As a true team player, you build relationships based on honesty, respect and trust and use your good communication skills to interact with colleagues and stakeholders at all levels.

What We offer

Sandvik offers a competitive total compensation package including comprehensive benefits. In addition, we provide opportunities for professional competence development and training, as well as opportunities for career advancement.

Our culture

At Sandvik, we’re tech driven, innovative and entrepreneurial. We believe that success is a team effort so we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture where people can be themselves and reach their full potential. So, we invest in supporting each other, learning together and celebrating our differences. Visit our stories hub, LinkedIn or Facebook to get to know us further.

Application

We look forward to your application and ask you to send it no later than July 24th, 2026.

Contact Information

For further information about this position, please contact:

Avantika Iyer, Recruitment Specialist

This role focuses on strategic leadership, team management, client consulting, and operational excellence rather than day-to-day execution.

The SEO Manager will oversee Team Leads and SEO Analysts, ensure consistent delivery standards, define long-term organic growth strategies, and align SEO performance with broader marketing and business objectives.   • Identify automation opportunities and encourage adoption of AI-driven SEO workflows to improve efficiency and scalability.
  • Act as the escalation point for complex SEO challenges, delivery risks, and client performance concerns.

Qualifications:

  • Minimum 5+ years of proven SEO experience with mandatory agency background and experience managing multiple client portfolios.
  • Demonstrated experience leading SEO teams in an agency environment.
  • Proven ability to connect SEO performance with business outcomes including lead generation, customer acquisition, and revenue contribution.
  • Strong strategic understanding of Technical SEO, Content SEO, Local SEO, and enterprise-scale organic growth frameworks.
  • Strong operational mindset with experience building scalable processes, workflows, and delivery standards.

  • Health insurance

Job Title: Maths Curriculum Specialist

Company: BrightChamps Location: Bangalore, Karnataka (Work from Office) Job Type: Full-time Experience: 5–7 years

About the Role

BrightChamps is looking for a Maths Curriculum Specialist to improve our existing Maths learning experience across demo and paid sessions. This is an optimisation role, not a content-building role — you'll use data, research, and AI tools to sharpen session flow, practice quality, student engagement, and conversion outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyse demo conversion data, student feedback, and retention signals to identify and fix curriculum and session-flow gaps
  • Audit practice sheets, quizzes, and worksheets across grades for accuracy, difficulty grading, and alignment to learning objectives
  • Benchmark our curriculum against Common Core (US), UK National Curriculum, Australian Curriculum, and leading EdTech competitors
  • Translate parent feedback and market insights into specific, actionable curriculum improvements
  • Use AI tools for research, question generation, and content review — with rigorous quality evaluation before anything goes live
  • Collaborate with Training, Quality, Product, and Business teams; document and standardise repeatable improvement processes
  • Support A/B tests and pilots of new session flows and track outcomes

Requirements

  • 5–7 years in Maths curriculum design, academic content development, teacher training, or learning experience design (K-12/EdTech preferred)
  • Strong Maths expertise across Grades 1–10, with depth in upper primary and middle school
  • Hands-on experience with international curricula: Common Core, UK National Curriculum, Australian Curriculum, Cambridge, IB, or equivalent
  • Practical comfort with AI tools and the judgment to critically evaluate AI-generated content
  • Process-oriented with strong written communication and documentation skills
  • Bachelor's degree mandatory; Education/Mathematics background preferred; B.Ed, M.Ed, or curriculum certification a plus

Why Join Us

  • Direct ownership of learning outcomes and conversion performance
  • Work at the intersection of academics, data, and applied AI
  • High-growth EdTech environment with global markets (US, UK, Australia, MEA)

Pay: Up to ₹1,200,000.00 per year

Benefits:

  • Health insurance
  • Paid sick time
  • Paid time off
  • Provident Fund

We are seeking a high-impact Delivery Manager - Data & AI Managed Services to lead strategic enterprise engagements focused on modern data platforms, AI enablement, analytics transformation, and business value realization. This role requires a unique blend of deep technical expertise, consulting leadership, operational excellence, innovation mindset, and customer relationship management.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end delivery and operational management of enterprise Data & AI managed services engagements.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to client executives, business stakeholders, and technology leadership teams.
  • Drive strategic roadmaps for data modernization, AI enablement, analytics transformation, and operational optimization.
  • Build and scale high-performing global delivery teams across onsite, nearshore, and offshore models.
  • Own delivery governance including KPIs, SLAs, financial management, risk mitigation, escalations, staffing, and client satisfaction.
  • Identify opportunities for account growth, expansion, innovation, and value-added services.
  • Partner with client stakeholders to define and prioritize data products, business capabilities, and AI-driven use cases.
  • Drive proactive consulting conversations around modernization, automation, data quality, governance, semantic models, and AI adoption.
  • Lead architecture and solution discussions for modern cloud data platforms.
  • Establish engineering best practices, reusable frameworks, accelerators, automation patterns, and operational excellence models.
  • Mentor technical leads and other team members while fostering a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate closely with sales, pre-sales, architecture, and executive leadership teams on proposals, estimations, solutioning, and strategic pursuits.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in enterprise data engineering, analytics, or data platform delivery.
  • 5+ years leading large-scale managed services or consulting engagements.
  • Proven experience managing complex global delivery teams across multiple geographies.
  • Strong consulting mindset with the ability to engage executive stakeholders and drive business-focused outcomes.
  • Deep expertise in Retail, Food & Beverage, and/or Entertainment industry domains.
  • Strong experience building and operationalizing enterprise data products and analytics solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive account growth, innovation initiatives, and strategic transformation programs.

Technical Expertise

  • Deep expertise in modern cloud data platforms and large-scale data ecosystems.
  • Strong hands-on architecture and engineering knowledge in:
    • Databricks
    • Microsoft Azure ecosystem
    • Azure Data Factory (ADF)
    • Delta Lake & Medallion Architecture
    • Data Lakehouse architectures
    • PySpark / Spark optimization
    • SQL and advanced data modeling
    • Real-time and batch data processing
    • Data governance and data quality frameworks
    • CI/CD and DataOps practices
    • API and integration patterns
  • Experience with AI/ML enablement, semantic models, conversational analytics, or Agentic AI ecosystems is highly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise architecture, scalability, security, observability, and platform operations.

Leadership Expectations

  • Operate as an owner and strategic leader, not just a project manager.
  • Bring strong executive presence and communication skills.
  • Drive innovation and challenge conventional approaches.
  • Build trusted client relationships and become a strategic partner.
  • Create a culture of engineering excellence, accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.
  • Inspire teams to deliver business outcomes with speed, quality, and operational rigor.

Preferred Background

Experience working with:
  • Enterprise Retail organizations
  • Restaurant / F&B brands
  • Entertainment and hospitality companies
  • Large-scale cloud modernization initiatives
  • Data platform managed services environments
  • Consulting or professional services organizations
This is an opportunity to lead transformative Data & AI initiatives for enterprise clients while helping shape next-generation data-driven organizations through modern engineering, consulting excellence, and innovation leadership.

Agile Product Owner Advisor - HIH - Evernorth

Position Overview:

The Agile Product Owner Advisor is a strategic and collaborative leader within an agile development team, responsible for managing the product backlog and ensuring that development efforts align with customer needs and business goals. This role involves translating high-level business requirements into clear, actionable features, defining acceptance criteria, and prioritizing work to maximize value delivery. The Product Owner serves as the voice of the customer, working closely with developers, architects, operations, and business stakeholders to guide product development through iterative cycles.

The Product Owner should embrace the “Product Mindset” and is expected to understand strategic roadmap goals, conduct customer interviews, analyze data, and participate in portfolio discussions to shape the product vision. They are empowered to support intake, prioritize delivery in partnership with business and Engineering, and ensure the Scrum team is focused on solving the right problems with innovative solutions. This role demands strong business and technical acumen, the ability to communicate effectively across teams, and a commitment to delivering measurable outcomes.

Responsibilities:

  • Understand and align product goals with strategic business objectives to ensure delivery of meaningful value.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with business and technology partners, fostering cross-functional collaboration.
  • Act as the primary contact for resolving escalations, removing impediments, and managing stakeholder negotiations and conflicts.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to onboard new initiatives and integrate them effectively into the product development lifecycle.
  • Support the development of specifications, including value propositions and technical financial estimates, to guide delivery planning.
  • Align with delivery teams to understand capacity and ensure prioritization is accurately reflected in the product backlog.
  • Own and refine the product backlog, maintaining a steady flow of well-defined work items for the development team.
  • Analyze business needs and support requirement gathering, architecture discussions, and design decisions within agile teams.
  • Translate business requirements into actionable features and define iteration scope to guide development.
  • Participate actively in agile ceremonies and respond to team inquiries, clarifying features and acceptance criteria.
  • Communicate the product vision and strategic decisions to the team, reinforcing customer-centric thinking and business rationale.
  • Conduct data analysis and profiling to support product decisions, including mapping source-to-target data and investigating issues using tools like SQL, SAS, or Python

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in MIS, Business, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 11-13 years of experience in data analysis; Healthcare data domain experience and Agile certification (e.g., SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager) are highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated experience as a Product Owner or in a similar role within Agile development environments, with a strong grasp of Agile principles, Scrum methodology, and modern delivery practices such as continuous integration and test-driven development.
  • Proven ability to translate complex business needs into clear, actionable features and acceptance criteria, with a focus on delivering customer-centric solutions.
  • Aptitude for gaining deep knowledge of the industry, business strategy, and key data domains (e.g., provider data, claims, membership, benefits), and proactively applying this knowledge to drive meaningful results.
  • Strong interpersonal and relationship management skills, with the ability to facilitate collaboration across multiple functions, departments, and levels.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills, with the ability to influence and negotiate effectively across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in Agile and collaboration tools (JIRA) with hands-on experience supporting agile ceremonies and backlog management.
  • Advanced data analysis capabilities, including experience with SQL tools (e.g.,Toad, SAS, Alation), and data profiling techniques; familiarity with cloud technologies and data warehousing is a plus.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate code, decode data issues, and support architecture and design decisions.
  • Exceptional organizational and work management skills, with experience managing dependencies, risks, and delivery timelines in dynamic, lean/agile environments.

Required Skills:

  • Data Analytics Platforms (Databricks and/or Snowflake)
  • Python, DevOps, Basic Cloud Experience (AWS/Azure).

Preferred Skills, Experience & Education:

  • Cloud Certification (AWS Cloud Practitioner or similar)

About Evernorth Health Services

Evernorth Health Services, a division of The Cigna Group, creates pharmacy, care and benefit solutions to improve health and increase vitality. We relentlessly innovate to make the prediction, prevention and treatment of illness and disease more accessible to millions of people. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.

Job Position: Linux/Windows System Administrator (L1)

Experience

  • Minimum 1 year of experience in IT Infrastructure, System Administration, or Technical Support.

Qualification

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related discipline.
  • Relevant technical certifications (Linux, Microsoft, CompTIA, etc.) will be an added advantage.

Job Summary

We are looking for a motivated and technically sound Linux/Windows System Administrator to join our Infrastructure team. The ideal candidate should possess basic knowledge of Linux and Windows operating systems, be capable of performing first-level troubleshooting, and support day-to-day IT infrastructure operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Install, configure, and maintain Windows and Linux operating systems.
  • Perform basic system administration tasks such as user creation, password resets, and permission management.
  • Monitor server health and system performance.
  • Troubleshoot hardware, software, operating system, and network-related issues.
  • Support installation and configuration of applications and system updates.
  • Assist in backup and recovery activities.
  • Monitor system logs and escalate critical issues to senior administrators.
  • Document incidents, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions.
  • Coordinate with internal teams and vendors to resolve infrastructure-related issues.
  • Ensure compliance with IT security policies and best practices.

Required Technical Skills

  • Basic knowledge of Linux operating systems (Ubuntu, CentOS, Red Hat, Oracle Linux, etc.).
  • Basic knowledge of Microsoft Windows Server and Windows desktop operating systems.
  • Understanding of file systems, user management, and permissions.
  • Basic networking knowledge including IP addressing, DNS, DHCP, and TCP/IP.
  • Familiarity with command-line utilities in Linux and Windows.
  • Basic understanding of Active Directory.
  • Knowledge of remote desktop tools and SSH.
  • Ability to perform basic troubleshooting for operating system, application, and network issues.

Soft Skills

  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work in a team-oriented environment.
  • Willingness to learn new technologies.
  • Ability to work in shifts, if required.

Preferred Skills

  • Exposure to virtualization technologies such as VMware or Hyper-V.
  • Basic knowledge of cloud platforms (OCI, AWS, or Azure) is an added advantage.
  • Understanding of ITIL processes and ticketing tools.

Key Competencies

  • Troubleshooting
  • System Administration
  • Technical Support
  • Incident Management
  • Documentation
  • Team Collaboration
  • Customer Service Orientation

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Job Title: R&D Data Engineering Lead

Location: Hyderabad

Job type: Permanent, Full time

About the Job

At Sanofi, we’re committed to providing the next-gen healthcare that patients and customers need. It’s about harnessing data insights and leveraging AI responsibly to search deeper and solve sooner than ever before. Join our R&D Data & AI Products and Platforms Team as a R&D Data Engineering Lead

and you can help make it happen.

What you will be doing:

Sanofi has recently embarked into a vast and ambitious digital transformation program. A cornerstone of this roadmap is the acceleration of its data transformation and of the adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) solutions, to accelerate R&D, manufacturing and commercial performance and bring better drugs and vaccines to patients faster, to improve health and save lives.

The R&D Data & AI Products and Platforms Team is a key team within R&D Digital, focused on developing and delivering Data and AI products for R&D use cases. This team plays a critical role in pursuing broader democratization of data across R&D and providing the foundation to scale AI/ML, advanced analytics, and operational analytics capabilities.

As an R&D Data Engineering Lead, you will join this dynamic team committed to driving strategic and operational digital priorities and initiatives in R&D. You will work as a part of a Data & AI Product Delivery Pod, lead by a Product Owner, in an agile environment to deliver Data & AI Products. As a part of this team, you will be responsible for the design and development of data pipelines and workflows to ingest, curate, process, and store large volumes of complex structured and unstructured data. You will have the ability to work on multiple data products serving multiple areas of the business.

Our vision for digital, data analytics and AI

Join us on our journey in enabling Sanofi’s Digital Transformation through becoming an AI first organization. This means:

  • AI Factory - Versatile Teams Operating in Cross Functional Pods: Utilizing digital and data resources to develop AI products, bringing data management, AI and product development skills to products, programs and projects to create an agile, fulfilling and meaningful work environment.
  • Leading Edge Tech Stack: Experience build products that will be deployed globally on a leading-edge tech stack.
  • World Class Mentorship and Training: Working with renown leaders and academics in machine learning to further develop your skillsets.

We are an innovative global healthcare company with one purpose: to chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. We’re also a company where you can flourish and grow your career, with countless opportunities to explore, make connections with people, and stretch the limits of what you thought was possible. Ready to get started?


Main Responsibilities:

Data Product Engineering:

  • Provide input into the engineering feasibility of developing specific R&D Data/AI Products
  • Provide input to Data/AI Product Owner and Scrum Master to support with planning, capacity, and resource estimates
  • Design, build, and maintain scalable and reusable ETL / ELT pipelines to ingest, transform, clean, and load data from sources into central platforms / repositories.
  • Structure and provision data to support modelling and data discovery, including filtering, tagging, joining, parsing and normalizing data
  • Collaborate with Data/AI Product Owner and Scrum Master to share Progress on engineering activities and inform of any delays, issues, bugs, or risks with proposed remediation plans
  • Design, develop, and deploy APIs, data feeds, or specific features required by product design and user stories
  • Optimize data workflows to drive high performance and reliability of implemented data products
  • Oversee and support junior engineer with Data/AI Product testing requirements and execution

Innovation & Team Collaboration:

  • Stay current on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in data product engineering
  • Contribute to a team culture of of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning within the product team

About You:

Key Functional Requirements & Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in software engineering or related field, or equivalent work experience
  • 8+ years of experience in data product engineering, software engineering, or other related field
  • Understanding of R&D business and data environment preferred
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Working knowledge and comfort working with Agile methodologies

Key Technical Requirements & Qualifications:

Mandatory Skills:

Programming & Data Languages:

  • Python
  • SQL

Cloud Platforms – AWS

  • Amazon S3
  • AWS Lambda
  • AWS Glue
  • Amazon EC2
  • AWS IAM
  • Amazon SQS
  • Amazon API Gateway
  • Amazon EventBridge
  • Amazon EMR
  • Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow (MWAA)

Cloud Data Warehouse:

  • Snowflake Data Modeling Performance Tuning Query Optimization

ETL / ELT & Data Integration:

  • Informatica Intelligent Cloud Services (IICS)
  • ETL Development
  • ELT Pipelines
  • Data Transformation

Data Orchestration & Transformation

  • Apache Airflow
  • dbt (Data Build Tool)

Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & DevOps

  • Terraform
  • CI/CD for Data Pipelines

Core Data Engineering Concepts

  • Data Modeling (Star Schema, Snowflake Schema)
  • Data Lake & Data Warehouse Architecture
  • Batch & Streaming Data Processing
  • API Integrations
  • Data Governance
  • Cloud-Native Architecture
  • Proven expertise in building scalable data pipelines and workflows

Nice to Have:

Generative AI & Advanced Data Platforms

  • AWS Bedrock (Agents, Agent Core)
  • Vector Databases (OpenSearch Vector Engine).
  • Understanding of Snowflake Cortex and Streamlit applications

Why Choose Us?

  • Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team
  • Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally
  • Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact
  • Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness programs

Pursue Progress. Discover Extraordinary.

Progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. You can be one of those people. Chasing change, embracing new ideas and exploring all the opportunities we have to offer. Let’s pursue progress. And let’s discover Extraordinary together.

At Sanofi, we provide equal opportunities to all regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.


Watch our ALL IN video and check out our Diversity Equity and Inclusion actions at sanofi.com!

Location: Ahmedabad (Work from Office)
Experience: 1–3 Years
Employment Type: Full-time

About Hind Social

Hind Social is building India's next-generation social platform that celebrates culture, communities, and meaningful connections. We're reimagining social networking by blending technology with Indian values, creating a platform where people connect beyond likes and followers.

We're looking for a curious and detail-oriented Manual QA Tester who is passionate about building high-quality consumer products and ensuring every feature delivers a seamless user experience.

What You'll Do

  • Understand product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Prepare comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scenarios.
  • Perform Functional, Regression, Smoke, Sanity, UI, Exploratory, Integration, and End-to-End testing.
  • Validate new features before every release across Web and Mobile applications.
  • Identify, reproduce, document, and track bugs using Jira.
  • Work closely with Product Managers, Designers, and Developers throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Verify bug fixes and perform regression testing before production releases.
  • Test APIs using Postman wherever required.
  • Validate backend data using SQL queries when needed.
  • Ensure application quality across different browsers, operating systems, and devices.
  • Participate in sprint planning, backlog grooming, QA reviews, and release sign-offs.
  • Suggest improvements to product quality, usability, and testing processes.
  • Maintain accurate testing documentation and release reports.

Required Skills

  • 1–3 years of experience in Manual Software Testing.
  • Strong understanding of SDLC and STLC.
  • Experience creating detailed test cases, checklists, and test reports.
  • Hands-on experience with Jira or similar bug-tracking tools.
  • Strong knowledge of:
  • Functional Testing
  • Regression Testing
  • Smoke & Sanity Testing
  • Exploratory Testing
  • UI/UX Testing
  • Cross-browser Testing
  • Mobile Application Testing
  • Basic understanding of REST APIs and Postman.
  • Basic SQL knowledge for database validation.
  • Excellent analytical and debugging skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced startup environment.

Good to Have

  • Exposure to Agile/Scrum methodology.
  • Knowledge of automation testing tools such as Selenium, Cypress, or Playwright.
  • Experience testing social media, messaging, or consumer internet applications.
  • Understanding of performance, security, and usability testing.
  • Familiarity with browser developer tools.
  • Experience testing responsive web applications.

Tech Environment

You'll work alongside teams building products using:

  • React.js
  • React Native
  • Node.js
  • AWS
  • PostgreSQL
  • ClickHouse
  • Metabase
  • Docker
  • Kubernetes
  • GitHub
  • Jira
  • Postman

What We're Looking For

  • Passion for building consumer internet products.
  • High attention to detail.
  • Strong ownership mindset.
  • Curiosity to explore edge cases.
  • Ability to think from the user's perspective.
  • Self-driven with a continuous learning attitude.
  • Comfortable working in a startup where ideas move quickly.

Why Join Hind Social?

  • Build a product with the potential to impact millions of users.
  • Work directly with founders and influence product quality.
  • High ownership and faster career growth.
  • Collaborative, transparent, and innovation-driven culture.
  • Opportunity to learn modern product development practices and emerging technologies.

If you believe great products are built through exceptional quality, we'd love to have you on our team.

Pay: ₹5,000.00 - ₹46,621.60 per month

Benefits:

  • Paid time off

Job Objective -

  • Seeking a Graphic Designer who can not only interpret business requirements but also set new benchmarks in creativity as we continue to scale. Who is not afraid of trying something new.
  • This role is responsible for executing design concepts and brand guidelines across creative projects, ensuring high-quality output for both offline and online branding for our Exclusive Branded Outlet, Doctor Marketing, and D2C channels.

Job Description:

  • Design finished artworks for a diverse range of branding, marketing, and communication materials including but not limited to packaging, brochures, POS display materials, visual merchandising, event collaterals, presentations, digital creatives, etc.
  • Work closely with the marketing and sales teams to translate campaign objectives and business requirements into effective design solutions.
  • Collaborate with the marketing team to design and execute static and video creative outputs for social media campaigns, ensuring high engagement and alignment with brand guidelines.
  • Support the creation of corporate collaterals such as presentations, company decks, and brochures.
  • Assist in monitoring campaign performance and revising creative assets to improve results based on feedback and analytics.
  • Evaluate trends, assess new data, and keep up to date with the latest design and marketing techniques to ensure BOHECO's branding remains dynamic, competitive, and relevant.
  • Maintain consistent brand communication and visual quality across all platforms, in coordination with the Design Head
  • Give and receive constructive feedback, fostering a collaborative and innovative design environment within the team.
  • Report progress of projects at major stages of their conception, creation, and execution
  • Leverage expert knowledge in consumer psychology to craft visually compelling marketing materials that resonate with diverse audience segments.
  • Collaborate with the marketing team to translate consumer behavior insights into design solutions that effectively communicate brand values and product benefits.
  • You will work in the Business Development & Marketing function. In this function, you will work under the Design Head as your supervisor.

Education:

  • Required: BSc/BA in Advertising, Fine Art, Design, Visual Communication, or a relevant field. Preferred: Masters.
  • Experience: 3-5 years of design experience with a strong portfolio emphasizing graphic design, visual communication, and branding.
  • Knowledge: Sound understanding of design principles, copywriting, web practices, marketing, production, website design, corporate identity, product packaging, advertisements, and multimedia design.

Skills:

  • Design Software Proficiency: Expertise in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects, etc.), CorelDraw, AI Tools, and familiarity with other relevant design and video editing tools.
  • Project Management: Strong time management and project coordination skills, capable of meeting tight deadlines and managing multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Communication: Excellent ability to give and receive constructive criticism, fostering a collaborative and innovative design environment.
  • Integrated Marketing: Experienced in creating content that spans all marketing channels, including digital, social media, paid media, and traditional print mediums.
  • Creative Leadership: Hands-on experience leading the creative process within marketing and graphic design projects, with a focus on brand development and maintaining brand integrity across all platforms.
  • Visual Storytelling: Strong visual storytelling skills, with a basic understanding of performance marketing concepts and how design influences campaign performance.
  • Attitude: Attention to detail and a caring, collaborative personality is a non-negotiable.
  • Good to Have: Basic hands-on understanding of photography and videography, including framing, lighting, composition, and camera fundamentals. While this role is primarily focused on graphic design, the ability to support shoots and understand visual production is expected

Who We're Looking For

  • Someone who is genuinely passionate about design and constantly looking to improve their craft.
  • A self-starter who takes ownership of projects from brief to final delivery.
  • Curious and open to learning new tools, techniques, and creative approaches.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can evolve.
  • Someone who enjoys collaboration, values feedback and contributes positively to the team.
  • Has a problem-solving mindset instead of waiting for instructions.
  • Pays close attention to detail and takes pride in delivering polished work.

Pay: ₹35,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

About this role:

Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Business Intelligence Consultant.


In this role, you will:

  • Lead or participate in moderately complex initiatives within the Business Intelligence functional area and contribute to large-scale planning related to business intelligence deliverables that enable clear and consistent delivery of insights
  • Review and analyze moderately complex business, operational, or technical challenges that require an in-depth evaluation of data interpretation and visualization methods to create diagnostic analytics and dashboards
  • Independently resolve moderately complex issues and lead team to meet data-related deliverables as it contributes to developing intuitive compelling outputs used to inform decisions and strategy
  • Leverage a solid understanding of data structures, domain specific knowledge, and the end-user experience to impact the final data visualization product, which includes dashboards, reports, insights, or analyses
  • Collaborate and consult with peers, colleagues, and mid-level managers to achieve goals related to assessing business needs and producing actionable insights and trends leveraging data visualization and business intelligence
  • Lead projects, teams and serve as a mentor for lower-level staff
  • Work to drive adoption of insights and metrics as a resource for the company to enable a data-driven decision-making approach


Required Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of business intelligence and data visualization experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education


Desired Qualifications:


Job Expectations:

Overview:
We are seeking a highly skilled, self-driven, results-oriented senior analytics consultant to support the data and analytics needs of the Chief Administrative Office (CAO). This is a business partner facing role and is responsible for providing reporting and analytic solutions that provide actionable insights to the line of business and enterprise function partners. This role includes understanding use case requirements, performing data analysis, developing semantic data models to support analytics and AI/ML model development and effective use of data visualization, reporting/dashboarding and AI-enabled BI solutions to enable explainability, exploratory analytics and actionable insights.

We are looking for a high performer to join our team and help us solve challenging and interesting business problems through rigorous data analysis and visualization. In this highly consultative and visible role, you will support business intelligence and analytics projects for leadership in key CAO functions.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather and refine requirements for use cases.
  • Develop and deliver end to end high performing reporting solutions and data analysis
  • Perform exploratory analysis to identify the co-relations existing in the data and generate insights.
  • Ability to leverage data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau) and alternative data manipulation and front-end solutions to deliver data analysis results and insights.
  • Capable of performing ad-hoc analyses and drill down into data inconsistencies and perform root cause analysis for unusual trends.
  • Work closely with Business and Technology Partners to generate new BI solutions or modify current work products to optimize capabilities and improve efficiency
  • Strong experience in evaluating different types of AI/ML outputs and models (recommender systems, similarity scoring, classification and regression).
  • Should be able to break down complex business problems into sub-tasks that can be solved with BI and analytics to enable decision making on a scale.
  • Should have good grasp on statistical concepts and empirical methods that drive post-modelling decisions like sorting, ranking, selection etc.
  • Be exceptional at communicating and translating model algorithms and their outputs to non-technical users and stakeholders, through visualization and BI tools like Power BI, Tableau.
  • Ability to integrate AI-enabled features (e.g. Copilot for Power BI) into end-user consumption interfaces to enable natural language led analysis for business users.
  • Fluent in agile ways of working and agile project management practices. Should be comfortable to create efficient user stories, and other agile project artifacts.

Essential qualifications & Skills:

  • 6+ (overall experience) years of experience in one or a combination of the following: reporting, analytics, or modeling (Tableau, Power BI, SQL, Python); or a Master’s degree or higher in a quantitative field such as applied math, statistics, engineering, computer sciences,
  • 5+ years of SQL, ETL, BI and PowerBI/Tableau programming experience
  • Business Intelligence
    • Proficiency in designing and implementing complex and interactive dashboards with BI tools like Power BI (including complex DAX implementations, embedded Power Apps and Power Automate workflows, Copilot for Power BI), Tableau
    • Experience in designing semantic data layers that power user centric dashboards/other consumption interfaces for analytics and AI/ML solutions, enabled with self-serve capabilities and embedded actionability.
    • Strong capability in using heterogeneous sources for deriving complex KPIs using Tableau, Power BI.
    • Understand high-level business objectives and continually align the BI/Reporting roadmap to needs of the business.
    • Experience on other BI tools like MSTR , BO , SSRS, Qlik will have an advantage
    • Strong oral and written communication and consultative skills.
    • Outstanding problem solving and analytical skills with ability to turn findings into strategic imperatives
    • Extensive knowledge and understanding of research, analysis, data aggregations, and reconciliation processes
    • Ability to perform trend analysis, forecasting and pattern recognition, exploratory data analysis and insights
  • Data analysis
    • Experience in data cleansing, validation, and transformation logic using Alteryx and SSMS.
    • Advanced exploratory data analysis skills using Python, SQL, excel etc., ability to write, read, and optimize queries for data extraction, transformation, and analysis
    • Experience with data environments like Oracle, Teradata, Sql server, HDFS, GCP
    • Designing and implementing enterprise data and reporting architectures, proficiency in semantic data modeling for BI and AI/ML solutions
    • Data integration and clean up/preparation of data
    • Experience with structured data and semi-structured text or Excel files
  • Familiarity with Agile processes and Atlassian software (Jira).

Desired Skills:

  • Exposure to data science, ML and AI concepts
  • Strong collaboration & problem-solving skills
  • Strong communication skills (presentation and narrative skills)
  • Ability to translate analytical data into useful business insights through presentation and storytelling
  • Self-driven and passionate about continuous learning
  • Knowledge of functional area such as risk, marketing, operations or supply chain in banking industry would be an added advantage.

Ability to multi-task and prioritize between projects, independently or as part of a team

Posting End Date:

7 Jul 2026
  • Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.

We Value Equal Opportunity

Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.

Candidates applying to job openings posted in Canada: Applications for employment are encouraged from all qualified candidates, including women, persons with disabilities, aboriginal peoples and visible minorities. Accommodation for applicants with disabilities is available upon request in connection with the recruitment process.

Applicants with Disabilities

To request a medical accommodation during the application or interview process, visit Disability Inclusion at Wells Fargo.

Drug and Alcohol Policy


Wells Fargo maintains a drug free workplace. Please see our Drug and Alcohol Policy to learn more.

Wells Fargo Recruitment and Hiring Requirements:

a. Third-Party recordings are prohibited unless authorized by Wells Fargo.

b. Wells Fargo requires you to directly represent your own experiences during the recruiting and hiring process.

The Research Analyst plays a key role in supporting corporate clients with their investor relations (IR) needs, ensuring accurate market data and insights.
The role maintains Miraqle, a global database of 65,000 buy- and sell-side contacts and 19,000 listed companies, helping clients engage effectively with investors.
Additionally, the analyst contributes to 200+ proxy solicitation campaigns annually, analysing investor data and delivering reports to support shareholder communication. By conducting research, liaising with third parties, and managing disclosure processes, the analyst provides valuable intelligence that strengthens investor engagement and corporate strategy.

Strategic Focus
  • Conduct in-depth market and investor research to support client engagement with shareholders.
  • Perform regular system audits to uphold data integrity and accuracy.
Operational Management
  • Serve as the primary contact for IR-related data research and analysis, ensuring client queries are addressed within 48 hours.
  • Maintain completeness and accuracy of all Miraqle database entries.
  • Generate timely and precise reports that support proxy solicitation campaigns and broader IR initiatives.
  • Ensure daily updates are reflected accurately within VoteTrak.
  • Address proxy-related inquiries from clients and CRM teams efficiently.
Governance & Risk
  • Establish and maintain daily communication with clients, ensuring their needs are met.
  • Engage with clients, fund managers, and back-office teams to verify investor holdings and voting intentions.

  • Relevant experience in research or data analysis, with a strong foundation in
  • analytical thinking
  • Minimum 18 months experience in research or data analysis.
  • Strong research and analytical skills with a high attention to detail
  • Interest in financial markets and their operations.
  • Strong attention to detail, time management, and initiative
  • Excellent communication skills, both spoken and written
  • Strong analytical abilities for data interpretation and problem-solving
  • Basic proficiency in Excel for managing and processing financial data
  • Team player with the ability to lead by example and adapt to evolving business needs.

description_html:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.


Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Introduction to the Team

Our Technology Team partners with teams across Expedia Group to create innovative products, services, and tools to deliver high-quality experiences for travelers, partners, and our employees. A singular technology platform powered by data and machine learning provides secure, differentiated, and personalized experiences that drive loyalty and traveler satisfaction.

We’re hiring a hands-on high-performing individual contributor to own and evolve a core Vacation Rental KPI . You will be responsible for turning complex data into clear, actionable insights for senior leaders.

You will lead analysis projects end-to-end—designing and building datasets, creating robust analytical products, and delivering high-impact dashboards and recommendations. You’ll follow team-wide visualization standards and use AI/LLM tools pragmatically to create efficiency and scale.

In this role, you will:

  • O wn a key KPI and its dashboard : Define, build, and maintain a stakeholder-facing dashboard that becomes the single source of truth for KPI health and performance.

  • Lead end-to-end analytics projects (scoping, data engineering, analysis, visualization, delivery) that drive measurable improvements in supply, quality, and conversion.
  • Build reliable, repeatable datasets and pipelines from multiple sources using SQL and scripting ( Python/R ), with strong attention to performance and data quality.
  • Create clear, persuasive visualizations and interactive dashboards (e.g., Tableau, Plotly, ggplot ) for both technical and non‑technical audiences, with a strong focus on storytelling and decision support.
  • High visibility : Own a core VR KPI and dashboard used by senior leaders to steer the VR business.
  • Direct, measurable impact : Your insights and recommendations will shape how we grow and optimize Vacation Rental supply.
  • Ownership and leadership : Lead analytics workstreams end-to-end, from problem framing to final recommendations and follow-through.
  • Modern toolkit : Work in a collaborative environment that embraces modern analytics, engineering, and AI tools to increase impact and scale.
  • Automate recurring reports and monitoring , including data-quality checks and alerting, to ensure stakeholders always have trusted, up-to-date views on key metrics.
  • Introduce and operationalize AI/LLM tools (e.g., for code generation, documentation, insight summarization, report automation) where they meaningfully increase productivity and scale.
  • Collaborate with product, marketing, operations, and data science teams to frame questions, translate business problems into analytical workstreams, and present trade-offs and recommendations.
  • Produce reproducible code and documentation , sharing artifacts via Git, Confluence , and team knowledge bases.
  • Apply statistical methods and intermediate ML approaches (e.g., regression, classification, clustering) when appropriate; partner with central Data Science to validate and scale models.
  • Design and analyze measurement strategies and experiments (A/B tests, pre/post analyses, causal impact, multivariate tests) for initiatives affecting VR inventory.

Experience & Qualifications:

  • Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Engineering , or related field (Master’s is a plus), or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2–3 years in a comparable analytics or data science role (with relevant degree), or 4+ years of directly relevant industry experience.
  • Advanced SQL (joins, window functions, performance tuning).
  • Strong proficiency in Python or R for data wrangling, analysis, and automation.
  • Experience combining multiple data sources and building repeatable, well-documented datasets .
  • Visualization & storytelling: Solid experience designing and maintaining dashboards in Tableau or similar BI tools .
  • Ability to translate complex analyses and metrics into simple, intuitive visuals and narratives for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Statistics & experimentation: Working knowledge of applied statistics and basic ML (e.g., AB testing, statistical significance, regression, pre/post and causal impact analyses).
  • Data engineering mindset: Familiarity with data modeling , pipeline design, and best practices for performance, reliability, and data quality .
  • Communication & stakeholder management: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to listen, gather requirements , and proactively manage expectations.
  • Comfortable presenting findings and recommendations to senior and executive stakeholders .
  • Ways of working: Critical thinker with strong business acumen and a bias for action.
  • Collaborative mindset and willingness to coach junior colleagues and share best practices.
  • Familiarity with AI/LLM tools and enthusiasm for using them to automate workflows, speed analyses, and scale insight delivery.

Accommodation requests

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job_accommodation .

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.


Important notice

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/ .


Equal Opportunity

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

Conduct live training sessions on Data Analytics concepts and tools.

Teach learners using practical examples, case studies, and real-world datasets.

Train students in Excel, SQL, Power BI, Python basics, data cleaning, data visualization, and reporting.

Prepare lesson plans, assignments, practice tasks, and project activities.

Guide students in completing portfolio projects and dashboards.

Evaluate student performance and provide regular feedback.

Support learners with doubts, assignments, and project reviews.

Ensure training is simple, practical, and industry-focused.

Strong knowledge of Data Analytics fundamentals.

Hands-on experience in:

Excel
SQL
Power BI
Python for Data Analysis
Data Visualization
Dashboard Creation
Reports and Business Insights

Good communication and presentation skills.

Ability to teach beginners in a simple and structured way.

Must have previous training or teaching experience.

Candidates from Kerala are preferred.

Experience as a Data Analyst, BI Analyst, MIS Executive, or Data Analytics Trainer will be an added advantage.

Knowledge of Tableau, Google Sheets, Looker Studio, or AI tools for analytics is an advantage.

Experience

Industry experience in data analytics will be an added advantage.

Full-time / Part-time / Freelance

As per experience and training ability.

The purpose of this role is to design, test and maintain software programs for operating systems or applications which needs to be deployed at a client end and ensure its meet 100% quality assurance parameters

͏

Do

1. Instrumental in understanding the requirements and design of the product/ software

Develop software solutions by studying information needs, studying systems flow, data usage and work processes
Investigating problem areas followed by the software development life cycle
Facilitate root cause analysis of the system issues and problem statement
Identify ideas to improve system performance and impact availability
Analyze client requirements and convert requirements to feasible design
Collaborate with functional teams or systems analysts who carry out the detailed investigation into software requirements
Conferring with project managers to obtain information on software capabilities
͏

2. Perform coding and ensure optimal software/ module development

Determine operational feasibility by evaluating analysis, problem definition, requirements, software development and proposed software
Develop and automate processes for software validation by setting up and designing test cases/scenarios/usage cases, and executing these cases
Modifying software to fix errors, adapt it to new hardware, improve its performance, or upgrade interfaces.
Analyzing information to recommend and plan the installation of new systems or modifications of an existing system
Ensuring that code is error free or has no bugs and test failure
Preparing reports on programming project specifications, activities and status
Ensure all the codes are raised as per the norm defined for project / program / account with clear description and replication patterns
Compile timely, comprehensive and accurate documentation and reports as requested
Coordinating with the team on daily project status and progress and documenting it
Providing feedback on usability and serviceability, trace the result to quality risk and report it to concerned stakeholders
͏

3. Status Reporting and Customer Focus on an ongoing basis with respect to project and its execution

Capturing all the requirements and clarifications from the client for better quality work
Taking feedback on the regular basis to ensure smooth and on time delivery
Participating in continuing education and training to remain current on best practices, learn new programming languages, and better assist other team members.
Consulting with engineering staff to evaluate software-hardware interfaces and develop specifications and performance requirements
Document and demonstrate solutions by developing documentation, flowcharts, layouts, diagrams, charts, code comments and clear code
Documenting very necessary details and reports in a formal way for proper understanding of software from client proposal to implementation
Ensure good quality of interaction with customer w.r.t. e-mail content, fault report tracking, voice calls, business etiquette etc
Timely Response to customer requests and no instances of complaints either internally or externally
͏

No. Performance Parameter Measure
1. Continuous Integration, Deployment & Monitoring of Software 100% error free on boarding & implementation, throughput %, Adherence to the schedule/ release plan

Job Description:
Job Description

Role Purpose

The purpose of this role is to design, test and maintain software programs for operating systems or applications which needs to be deployed at a client end and ensure its meet 100% quality assurance parameters

͏

Do

1. Instrumental in understanding the requirements and design of the product/ software

Develop software solutions by studying information needs, studying systems flow, data usage and work processes
Investigating problem areas followed by the software development life cycle
Facilitate root cause analysis of the system issues and problem statement
Identify ideas to improve system performance and impact availability
Analyze client requirements and convert requirements to feasible design
Collaborate with functional teams or systems analysts who carry out the detailed investigation into software requirements
Conferring with project managers to obtain information on software capabilities
͏

2. Perform coding and ensure optimal software/ module development

Determine operational feasibility by evaluating analysis, problem definition, requirements, software development and proposed software
Develop and automate processes for software validation by setting up and designing test cases/scenarios/usage cases, and executing these cases
Modifying software to fix errors, adapt it to new hardware, improve its performance, or upgrade interfaces.
Analyzing information to recommend and plan the installation of new systems or modifications of an existing system
Ensuring that code is error free or has no bugs and test failure
Preparing reports on programming project specifications, activities and status
Ensure all the codes are raised as per the norm defined for project / program / account with clear description and replication patterns
Compile timely, comprehensive and accurate documentation and reports as requested
Coordinating with the team on daily project status and progress and documenting it
Providing feedback on usability and serviceability, trace the result to quality risk and report it to concerned stakeholders
͏

3. Status Reporting and Customer Focus on an ongoing basis with respect to project and its execution

Capturing all the requirements and clarifications from the client for better quality work
Taking feedback on the regular basis to ensure smooth and on time delivery
Participating in continuing education and training to remain current on best practices, learn new programming languages, and better assist other team members.
Consulting with engineering staff to evaluate software-hardware interfaces and develop specifications and performance requirements
Document and demonstrate solutions by developing documentation, flowcharts, layouts, diagrams, charts, code comments and clear code
Documenting very necessary details and reports in a formal way for proper understanding of software from client proposal to implementation
Ensure good quality of interaction with customer w.r.t. e-mail content, fault report tracking, voice calls, business etiquette etc
Timely Response to customer requests and no instances of complaints either internally or externally
͏

Deliver

No. Performance Parameter Measure
1. Continuous Integration, Deployment & Monitoring of Software 100% error free on boarding & implementation, throughput %, Adherence to the schedule/ release plan
2. Quality & CSAT On-Time Delivery, Manage software, Troubleshoot queries, Customer experience, completion of assigned certifications for skill upgradation
3. MIS & Reporting 100% on time MIS & report generation

Mandatory Skills: Python for Insights .

Experience: 5-8 Years .

Project Role : Custom Software Engineer
Project Role Description : Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs.
Must have skills : Spring Boot
Good to have skills : NA
Minimum 5 year(s) of experience is required
Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Summary:
As a Custom Software Engineer, you will engage in the development of custom software solutions that involve designing, coding, and enhancing various components across systems or applications. Your typical day will include collaborating with team members to utilize modern frameworks and agile practices, ensuring the delivery of scalable and high-performing solutions that are tailored to meet specific business needs. You will also be involved in troubleshooting and optimizing existing software components to improve functionality and performance, while continuously seeking opportunities for innovation and improvement in the software development process.

Roles & Responsibilities:
Develop, maintain, and enhance test scripts for TCU validation using Java-based automation frameworks (ET Framework or similar).
Collaborate with firmware and system engineers to understand requirements and translate them into test cases.
Execute automated test scripts, analyze results, and report defects with clear documentation.
Contribute to continuous integration efforts for automated testing.
Participate in Agile/Scrum meetings and deliver timely updates on task progress.
Support team in debugging test bench issues or inconsistencies in results

Professional & Technical Skills:
Proficient in Java (Object-Oriented Programming, Collections, File I/O, etc.)
Java with Spring Boot having Microservices Background.
Familiarity with Apache Flink/Apache Kafka/Azure Eventhubs, AKS/EKS, Docker/Kubernetes, Datadog/Grafana/Prometheus/Splunk, Terraform
Familiarity with dependency injection, annotations, configuration properties, and Spring test utilities.
Practical experience with Spring Framework for building and structuring automation components.
Experience in developing test automation and REST API validation using Java.
Strong hands-on experience in Java (8 or above), with good knowledge of OOP principles, exception handling, multithreading, and collections framework.
Proficient in writing unit tests using JUnit and mocking frameworks like Mockito.
Knowledge of automotive communication protocols or embedded systems testing is a plus.
Familiarity with version control tools like Git/ GitLab
Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
Good verbal and written communication.
Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team environment.
Attention to detail and ownership of assigned modules.
Exposure to ET Framework or other proprietary test frameworks.
Understanding of TCU or connected vehicle technologies.
Automotive domain experience.

Additional Information:
  • The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in Java Full Stack Development.
  • This position is based at our Bengaluru office.
  • A Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science or related field is required.

15 years full time education

description_html:
Adheres to all phases of the application software development lifecycle. Applies working knowledge to develop and review code for application features and enhancements following design specifications, and develops documents to clarify application design and code. Conducts debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix simple and moderately complex application issues. Develops fixes for identified issues. Troubleshoots and resolves standard and non-standard issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality, integration, and service-to-service interactions. Collaborates with own team and begins to network outside of the team to understand customer use cases and align application solutions. May provide technical guidance and support to customers regarding application-related issues, with limited supervision. Begins to collaborate with the team to establish and follow application development practices, secure coding standards, and code quality. Performs periodic maintenance and testing operations for application systems that require upgrading or patching (e.g., for critical vulnerabilities), with limited guidance.

Key Responsibilities
Application Software Development:

  • Delivers small-to-medium features end-to-end within a single application.
  • Provides production support during business hours; participates in incident rotations with guidance.
  • Troubleshoots routine and some non-routine issues across app services and straightforward OCI/integration paths.
  • Coordinates with QA/engineering on test coverage and release readiness.
  • Applies architectural guidelines; raises design questions when needed.
  • Breaks down requirements into maintainable modules and tests.
  • Integrates and documents API dependencies for assigned features.
  • Contributes input to team-level build priorities based on reliability/scalability needs.
  • References forums/live-site reports to improve acceptance criteria.
  • Collaborates with Designers/PMs/engineers to clarify requirements.

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization:

  • Contributes to designing software solutions and analyzes requirements to achieve business and operational goals, with limited guidance.
  • Adheres to all phases of the software development lifecycle.
  • Applies working knowledge to develop and review code for new software features and enhancements following design specifications and develops documents to clarify software design and code.
  • Conducts debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix simple and moderately complex software issues.
  • Develops fixes for identified issues.
  • Implements software testing (e.g., functional testing), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging, following established frameworks.
  • Supports the implementation of standard and non-standard performance profiling and optimization of coding.
  • Troubleshoots and resolves standard and non-standard issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration.
  • Implements standard and non-standard API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies.

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support:

  • Collaborates with own team and begins to network outside of team to understand customer issues and align solutions.

  • May provide technical guidance and support to customers regarding customer-reported issues, with limited supervision.

  • Assists peers to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback.

  • Influences efforts to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication.

  • Utilizes working knowledge to implement customer issue and/or defect handling and training processes, with some guidance.

  • Collaborates with experienced colleagues to investigate and troubleshoot product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions.

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance:

  • Begins to collaborate with the team to establish and follow development practices and coding standards.

  • Assists in ensuring code quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development.

  • Demonstrates working knowledge of industry best practices and applies them to software development processes.

  • Assists in implementing secure coding practices to prevent security vulnerabilities.

Development Operations - System Maintenance:

  • Performs periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e.g., for critical vulnerabilities), with limited guidance.

  • Assists in driving improvements, ensures automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability.

Core Responsibilities
Planning & Execution:

  • Tracks timelines with minimal supervision, ensuring work is completed in a timely manner and is in alignment with project requirements. Prioritizes and adjusts work as resources or timelines change, with some guidance.

Collaboration & Partnership:

  • Collaborates within a team to better understand expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages a foundational understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build partnerships with limited guidance. Actively listens and asks questions to enhance collaboration.

Problem Solving:

  • Identifies and addresses issues, escalating problems to senior staff as needed in accordance with standard procedures. Compiles and reviews data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors.

Continuous Learning:

  • Seeks opportunities to gain knowledge and learn new skills and/or tools aligned with industry trends and best practices. Utilizes feedback and training to improve skills. Participates in a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing.

Continuous Improvement:

  • Implements updates to processes, protocols, and workflows to increase efficiency and effectiveness as directed with some guidance. Contributes to ideation for future process improvements.
