Job Description:


Job Title

Sr. D&T Engineer – Intelligent Automation


Location


Mumbai/Pune


Work Type


Hybrid


We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one other and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.

OVERVIEW

The Digital and Technology team of General Mills India Centre is looking for a passionate and enthusiastic individual to contribute to the Global Digital Transformation initiative at General Mills in capacity of a Senior Intelligent Automation Engineer. This role will report into the Manager, Intelligent Automation (India) and functionally collaborate with our Global Intelligent Automation Team. In this technical role, the Senior Intelligent Automation Engineer will act as a Technical Lead, owning the end-to-end delivery of automation programs through Azure DevOps while providing technical direction for solutions built on enterprise IA platforms such as Automation Anywhere A360 and ServiceNow App Engine, including emerging agentic AI capabilities.


KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

The Digital & Technology team at General Mills is seeking a Senior Intelligent Automation Engineer to act as a Technical Lead within the Intelligent Automation team. This is an individual contributor role that owns the end-to-end delivery of automation programs, backed by enough technical depth in Intelligent Automation to lead the solutions credibly, and would typically have the following key accountabilities:

Delivery Ownership (core focus):
  • Own end-to-end delivery of the automation programs assigned to this role, from planning to production handover.
  • Run and manage Azure DevOps for owned delivery, including boards, workflows, and activity tracking.
  • Plan, track, and report delivery across the owned portfolio, covering scope, timelines, resources, risks, and dependencies.
  • Manage scope and change through the appropriate change control.
  • Work within the Azure DevOps standards and cadence owned by the team's delivery governance lead, and hold owned delivery to them.
  • Coordinate across globally distributed teams to deliver on time and within budget.
Technical Leadership (core focus):
  • Provide technical direction for the automation solutions delivered by this role and make the key technical decisions on them.
  • Reason about agentic solution design and delivery risk as the team scales in this area, and guide design choices accordingly.
  • Review solution quality on owned programs and uphold the engineering standards set for the team.
  • Mentor and coach automation engineers on the delivery and technical quality of their work.
  • Evaluate emerging Intelligent Automation and agentic technologies and recommend where to adopt them.
Solution Delivery and Support (hands-on as required):
  • Guide automation solutions end to end, from process analysis through production.
  • Build prototypes and proofs of concept to de-risk design decisions early.
  • Design integrations between automation platforms and enterprise systems such as SAP, CRM, web portals, and cloud and on-premise applications.
  • Step into L2 / L3 support for automation solutions when issues escalate or the situation requires it, and lead resolution of complex or critical production incidents.
  • Contribute to or review code on critical, complex, or high-risk components.
Collaboration:
  • Partner with the D&T IA Manager who owns Azure DevOps standards and adherence across the team.
  • Partner with AI Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, and UX specialists rather than duplicating their scope.
  • Work with business SMEs to translate process needs into technical designs and solutions.
  • Align with platform, data, and security teams to deliver compliant, supportable solutions.
  • Coordinate priorities and progress with global stakeholders.
Continuous Improvement:
  • Re-engineer and improve existing automations for performance, reliability, and reusability.
  • Build and maintain a library of reusable components and design patterns.
  • Contribute to the Intelligent Automation operating model, standards, and best practices

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS


Education: Minimum Degree Requirements: Bachelors (Full time from accredited institution)
Experience: Minimum 8 years of experience required in Python, Agentic/AI Automation, Automation Anywhere/ServiceNow Development, LangChain/RAG/MCP, RPA
Technical Skills:
  • Proven experience owning delivery of technical automation programs end to end, covering planning, tracking, risk, dependencies, and stakeholder management. Generic project management without hands-on technical delivery is not a substitute.
  • Strong, practical command of Azure DevOps for running and tracking delivery, including boards, workflows, and activity tracking.
  • A solid technical background in Intelligent Automation, with hands-on experience in at least one enterprise automation platform such as Automation Anywhere A360 or ServiceNow App Engine. Depth in both is not required.
  • A working understanding of agentic AI, able to reason independently about agentic solution design and delivery risk as the team scales in this area. Building the underlying AI models or framework internals is not expected.
  • Solid programming ability in Python and comfort with at least one scripting language such as JavaScript or C#.
  • API and enterprise integration experience, including REST, SOAP, and webhooks, across systems such as SAP, CRM, cloud, and on-premise applications.
  • Working knowledge of relational databases (SQL) and of cloud environments and data flows.
  • Ability to provide technical direction on automation solutions, review solution quality, and mentor engineers on the work they deliver.
  • Ability to evaluate emerging Intelligent Automation technologies and make sound adopt, build, or buy recommendations.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Preferred:

  • Hands-on experience across more than one automation platform, for example both Automation Anywhere and ServiceNow.
  • Practical experience designing agentic solutions with frameworks or patterns such as LangChain, RAG, or MCP.
  • Experience with intelligent OCR or document processing.
  • Experience integrating Microsoft 365 or Power Platform.
  • DevOps tooling and CI/CD familiarity.
Nice to have:
  • Process or task mining experience.
  • SAP functional or integration exposure.
  • Familiarity with a JavaScript framework such as React, Angular, or Vue for occasional interface work.
  • SharePoint or Power Apps development.
  • Exposure to conversational and agent UX patterns, enough to collaborate well with UX specialists rather than to own design.

  • Experience with source control systems such as Git
  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies
  • Good understanding of Object-Oriented Design, Design Patterns, and Software Engineering principles
  • Understanding of CI/CD concepts and DevOps practices
  • Proven solid analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills
  • Proven excellent communication and collaboration abilities

We are seeking a technically proficient Full Stack Software Developer with a strong background in C#, Microsoft .NET Core, Microsoft ASP.NET, Microsoft Entity Framework,SQL Server (CRUD, Stored Procedures, Views, etc), Mongo DB (NOSQL), Microsoft Blazor (with Bootstrap Blazor) Web designing (HTML, CSS,, Javascript), and cloud technologies, particularly AWS. description_html:
At Corsearch, we are dedicated to creating a world where consumers can trust the choices they make.

As a global leader in Trademark and Brand Protection, we partner with businesses to safeguard their most valuable assets in an increasingly complex digital environment.

Our comprehensive solutions, powered by AI-driven data and deep analytics, enable brands to establish, monitor, and protect their presence against infringement and counterfeiting.

Why Choose Corsearch?

  • Innovative Solutions: We combine cutting-edge technology with expert judgment to deliver market-leading services in trademark clearance, brand protection, and anti-counterfeiting.

  • Global Impact: Trusted by over 5,000 customers worldwide, including 73 of Fortune's Top 100 companies, our work has a meaningful impact on businesses and consumers alike.

  • Collaborative Culture: With a team of over 1,900 professionals across multiple global offices, you'll be joining an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives thrive.

  • Mission-Driven Purpose: Our commitment to protecting consumers and their trust in brands drives everything we do, making Corsearch a force for good in the world.

The Role

We are seeking a Software Engineer with a strong background in infrastructure and a passion for building robust backend systems. In this role, you will play a pivotal part in managing and evolving our core infrastructure, which is responsible for handling massive, high-load web scraping operations and integrating complex scraping systems.
Scale of Data & Ingestion: Because our platform simultaneously powers operations for thousands of large-scale B2B enterprise clients, our infrastructure processes, transforms, and stores millions of data points and permanent web posts every single day. You will directly manage the high-concurrency ingestion pipelines required to scale these massive data ecosystems.
You will focus heavily on optimizing performance and cost efficiency, particularly by migrating machine learning and data extraction models from CPUs to high-performance GPU environments using Kubernetes.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • High-Load Infrastructure Management: Maintain, scale, and optimize the underlying core infrastructure that powers our high-volume scraping operations to effortlessly sustain the data demands of thousands of clients.

  • GPU Migration & Optimization: Cooperate on transitioning machine learning models (such as logo detection) from expensive CPU setups to cost-effective GPU deployments using Kubernetes. Validate GPU outputs rigorously against CPU baselines to ensure scaling efficiency.

  • System Decommissioning: Help identify, deprecate, and decommission legacy, inefficient scraping infrastructure to continually reduce operational overhead and streamline our high-load data pipelines.

  • Full-Stack Contributions: Comfortably work across the stack when needed, building and maintaining JavaScript-based front-end/back-end components that integrate with our core infrastructure.


Essential


  • 3+ Years of Experience:     Minimum of 3+ years of hands-on professional software engineering experience, ideally in backend or infrastructure-heavy roles.

  • Golang or Python Proficiency: Strong, practical experience writing backend services in either Go or Python is a strict requirement for this role. If your primary expertise is in Python, you must be fully willing and motivated to learn, adapt, and develop primarily in Go moving forward.

  • Full-Stack / JavaScript: Comfortable working across the stack, with solid hands-on experience in JavaScript (react.js and/or modern frontend frameworks) to support full-stack development needs.

  • Containerization & Orchestration: Proven experience deploying, scaling, and managing heavy workloads using Kubernetes.

  • Cloud Infrastructure: Solid foundational experience working within AWS (Amazon Web Services) environments where our operations live.


Corsearch is an equal opportunity and inclusive employer and does not tolerate discrimination of any kind. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued, respected, and supported.

We welcome applications from all individuals regardless of race, nationality, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, criminal histories consistent with legal requirements or any other protected characteristic.

Together, we are working proactively to build a workplace where everyone can belong and be at their best selves. Together, we make an Impact.

Innovate in Bengaluru

This position is based at our on-site office in Bengaluru. Lowe's offers an ultramodern work environment, complete with cutting-edge technology, collaborative workspaces, an on-site gym and clinic, and other perks to enhance your work experience.


About Lowe’s

Lowe’s is a FORTUNE® 100 home improvement company serving approximately 16 million customer transactions a week in the United States. With total fiscal year 2024 sales of more than $83 billion, Lowe’s operates over 1,700 home improvement stores and employs approximately 300,000 associates. Based in Mooresville, N.C., Lowe’s supports the communities it serves through programs focused on creating safe, affordable housing, improving community spaces, helping to develop the next generation of skilled trade experts and providing disaster relief to communities in need. For more information, visit Lowes.com

Lowe’s India, the Global Capability Center of Lowe’s Companies Inc., is a hub for driving our technology, business, analytics, and shared services strategy. Based in Bengaluru with over 4,500 associates, it powers innovations across omnichannel retail, AI/ML, enterprise architecture, supply chain, and customer experience. From supporting and launching homegrown solutions to fostering innovation through its Catalyze platform, Lowe’s India plays a pivotal role in transforming home improvement retail while upholding strong commitment to social impact and sustainability. For more information, visit Lowes India

About the Team

The Financial Decision Support & Analytics (FDS&A) team delivers analyses, insights, and reporting that identify key performance drivers and guide strategic and tactical decisions. We partner with US Retail Finance teams—including Global FP&A, Store Operations, Merchandising, and Supply Chain—to enable better business outcomes through data-driven insights.

Job Summary:

We are seeking a highly motivated Senior Analyst to join our Corporate Finance team in FDS&A. In this role, you will work closely with business and finance partners to solve complex problems, design impactful reports and tools, and deliver actionable insights that drive performance improvement.

This role requires retail finance acumen, financial modeling and forecasting, curiosity, analytical rigor, and strong communication and collaboration skills to influence decision-making in a dynamic, fast-paced environment

Roles & Responsibilities:

Core Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the go-to partner for forecasting sales and margin of specified product categories
  • Provide proactive rapid actionable insights by analyzing data and reporting
  • Own ideation and execution of analyses with little support
  • Design, develop, and automate dashboards and reports that bring out actionable insights
  • Quickly grasp business problems and translate into tangible, usable actionable outputs
  • Drive data-driven tactical conversations to be discussed in executive meetings and business reviews
  • Work with large, complex, and disparate datasets to generate meaningful inferences and recommendations with little support
  • Communicate findings clearly and persuasively to stakeholders across multiple levels of the organization
  • Build strong relationships with cross-functional partners while continuously pursuing self-development and new analytical approaches

Years of Experience:

  • 4-6 years of experience in analytics or financial decision support in retail

Education Qualification & Certifications

Required Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in finance, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics or related quantitative field

Skill Set Required

  • Strong skills in data collection, cleansing, and analysis using SQL, SAS, R, or Python
  • Advanced knowledge of Excel (Power Pivots, Power Query, VBA) and PowerPoint
  • Strong experience with at least one data visualization tool (e.g., MicroStrategy, Tableau, Power BI)
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple competing priorities
  • Excellent communication skills – being able to communicate effectively - upward, peers and offshore teams.

About

Calpion is an 18-year-old Dallas-headquartered technology firm that offers customers artificial intelligence solutions by building custom deep learning and machine learning algorithms, custom enterprise application development and maintenance, RPA solutions, cloud services, Salesforce consulting, customized invoice management software solutions, and other technology services. We also offer automated bot-driven medical billing services. Our healthcare offering includes a Salesforce platform-based practice management and billing software with automated patient e-statements and a payment portal.

Along with being SOC-certified and HIPPA-compliant, we have:

  • Helped Fortune 500 companies build custom enterprise-level applications.

Calpion offers a unique work environment that is both thrilling and enriching, fostering personal and professional growth. Our company is a hub of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning, where we encourage our employees to adopt a positive mindset and strive for excellence.

At Calpion, you'll be part of a vibrant team that thrives on creativity and problem-solving. You'll have the chance to work on cutting-edge projects, harnessing the latest technologies and methodologies to deliver intelligent solutions that make a real difference for our clients.

Calpion prioritizes the well-being of its employees and fosters a supportive and inclusive culture that promotes work-life balance. If you are enthusiastic about joining a vibrant organization that values your input, Calpion is the ideal place to pursue your career goals. ‍

Job Title: Python Developer

Company: Calpion Software India Pvt. Ltd

Location: Bengaluru, India

Role: Independent Contributor ‍

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Python Developer to join our dynamic product development team. As an Independent Contributor, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining robust and scalable Python applications. You will work closely with business teams to understand requirements and deliver innovative solutions that drive our product forward. ‍

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-quality Python applications, following best practices and coding standards.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand product requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
  • Develop and maintain APIs and integrations with third-party systems.
  • Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code.
  • Conduct thorough testing and quality assurance to ensure application reliability and performance.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues promptly.
  • Stay updated with the latest Python technologies and industry trends. ‍

Required Skills and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • Proven experience as a Python Developer with a strong understanding Python programming concepts and libraries. With hands-on experience of 3+ years
  • Proficiency in Python frameworks such as Pandas
  • Experience with database management systems (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL).
  • Knowledge of RESTful APIs and API design principles. Experience in writing and publishing the API
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to work independently and meet deadlines. ‍

Preferred: Experience in the US healthcare industry or Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) domain. ‍


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • Collaborative and supportive work environment. ‍

Our Culture & Values

At Calpion, we're not just a company—we're a dynamic culture fueled by six core values: Agile, Collaborative, Innovative, Fun, Inclusive, and Passionate. These values drive our every move:

  • Agile: We thrive on change, adapting swiftly to new challenges.
  • Collaborative: Together, we achieve greatness through teamwork and diverse perspectives.
  • Innovative: We push boundaries, constantly exploring new ideas and solutions.
  • Fun: Laughter and camaraderie make our workplace a joyous one.
  • Inclusive: Diversity is our strength, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Passionate: We approach every task with dedication and enthusiasm. ‍

Join us at Calpion and be part of a culture that's not just about work—innovation, growth, and making an impact.


Email us at:
indiatag@calpion.com

Job Description:

The opportunity:

We are looking for a hands-on and detail-driven Operational Buyer / SCM Financial Operations

Analyst to execute daily financial and transactional activities within Supply Chain Management.

This role is highly operational and execution-focused, ensuring accurate invoice processing,

payment management, PO monitoring, and logistics cost control, while also supporting Financial,

Controlling and SCM community to avoid supply disruptions, and strengthens overall supply chain

performance.The position plays a key role in maintaining financial accuracy, cost visibility, and supplier

performance, while actively supporting continuous improvement initiatives.

How you’ll make an impact:

  • Process supplier invoices end-to-end using VIM and SAP, ensuring accurate coding, cost allocation, and timely payment.

  • Validate invoices against Purchase Orders (POs), contracts, and goods/service receipts to ensure compliance and accuracy.

  • Resolve invoice discrepancies by coordinating with suppliers, Finance, SCM, and internal stakeholders.

  • Manage PO corrections and commercial adjustments in SAP when required.

  • Monitor GR/IR reconciliation, aged POs, and outstanding commitments to ensure financial accuracy and timely invoice submission.

  • Support monthly closing activities by maintaining visibility of accruals and resolving PO-GR-Invoice mismatches.

  • Monitor logistics-related costs, including freight, customs duties, and transportation expenses, ensuring accurate accounting and compliance.

  • Track spend and cost trends, presenting insights on logistics, duties, premium freight, and related expenditures.

  • Improve payment performance by managing overdue invoices, resolving supplier payment issues, and ensuring adherence to payment terms.

  • Collaborate with Finance, Supply Chain, and suppliers to resolve transactional issues and prevent supplier credit blocks or disruptions.

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives through process standardization, automation, digitalization, and reduction of manual interventions.

  • Track key KPIs including invoice cycle time, invoice accuracy, blocked invoice resolution, GR/IR aging, on-time payments, compliance, logistics cost accuracy, and touchless invoice adoption.

  • Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.

  • Living Hitachi Energy’s core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

Your background:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field.

  • 1–4 years of experience in Accounts Payable (AP), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Source-to-Pay (S2P), Procurement Operations, or SCM Finance support roles.

  • Hands-on experience with SAP and VIM (preferred), with a strong understanding of Procure-to-Pay processes.

  • Advanced Excel and reporting skills, including data validation, tracking, analysis, and dashboard management.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities to identify discrepancies, improve accuracy, and drive operational efficiency.

  • High attention to detail and execution discipline, with the ability to manage high transaction volumes accurately.

  • Collaborative and proactive mindset, working effectively with Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, and business stakeholders.

  • Continuous improvement focus, ensuring financial discipline, supporting savings initiatives, and driving process automation and standardization

Accessibility and reasonable accommodation

Qualified individuals with a disability may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the Hitachi Energy career site as a result of your disability. You may request reasonable accommodations by completing a general inquiry form on our website. Please include your contact information and specific details about your required accommodation to support you during the job application process.


This is solely for job seekers with disabilities requiring accessibility assistance or an accommodation in the job application process. Messages left for other purposes will not receive a response.


Use of Al and automated tools in recruitment

As part of our recruitment process, Hitachi Energy uses digital and automated tools, including Al-supported solutions, to assist with activities such as application screening, job matching, and interview scheduling. These tools are designed to support our recruiters and do not replace human decision-making. Candidate data is processed in accordance with applicable data protection and employment laws as well as Hitachi's Global Data Privacy Notice.

Background Screening and Security Checks

As part of the hiring process, Hitachi Energy conducts pre-employment background checks that may include verification of employment history, education, criminal records, and other relevant information, in accordance with applicable laws.

For certain roles—particularly those involving access to sensitive information, financial responsibilities, client data, regulated environments, or security-sensitive functions—additional or more comprehensive background or security screenings may be required. These may include, but are not limited to, enhanced criminal history checks, credit history reviews (where legally permissible), sanctions screening, or other due diligence measures aligned with the responsibilities of the position.

The scope and depth of any background or security review will be determined based on the nature of the role and business necessity, and will always be conducted in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Candidates will be notified and, where required, asked to provide consent prior to the initiation of any such checks.

DESCRIPTION

We are looking for an L6 Business Intelligence Engineer (BIE) Manager to lead a team of BIEs supporting Cross Border Science at Amazon. This role sits at the intersection of data engineering, analytics, and applied science — owning the BI infrastructure and insights layer that powers AI-driven decision-making across 50+ Cross Border arcs and 8+ marketplace geographies. The ideal candidate will build and manage a team that delivers production-grade BI pipelines, experimentation frameworks, and business metrics instrumentation supporting science initiatives spanning forecasting, pricing, personalization, search, compliance, and generative AI. You will partner closely with Applied Scientists, Product Managers, and Software Engineers to translate complex, multi-marketplace data into actionable intelligence — defining KPIs, building self-service dashboards, and designing A/B test measurement frameworks that quantify the business impact of tech and AI solutions in production. This is a high-visibility role requiring both technical depth (SQL, Spark, Python, AWS data stack) and leadership maturity to hire, develop, and mentor BIEs while operating as a strategic partner to science and product leadership.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • 7+ years of business intelligence and analytics experience
  • 5+ years of delivering results managing a business intelligence or analytics team, including employee development and performance management experience
  • Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
  • Experience in SQL Server/MySQL, or experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities and experience in Redshift
  • Experience including, building and maintaining data flows and pipelines
  • Knowledge of product experimentation (A/B testing)

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience leveraging LLMs and GenAI tools for analytics workflows — prompt-based data exploration, automated insight generation, natural language to SQL, or AI-assisted reporting
  • Experience building semantic layers or self-service analytics platforms that democratize data access across technical and non-technical consumers
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted data quality and anomaly detection — automated monitoring of data freshness, drift, and pipeline health using ML-based alerting

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

ARC Technologies and Institutions is looking for an experienced Data Analyst Trainer who can deliver strong conceptual knowledge along with hands-on industry-oriented training. * Provide practical, hands-on learning using live datasets

* Train candidates on industry-level projects and case studies

* Ability to explain complex concepts in a simple, structured manner

* Passion for teaching and upskilling freshers and working professionals

* Hands-on experience with real-time or industrial projects

Experience

* Training experience will be an added advantage

* Opportunity to work with aspiring data professionals

* Professional training environment

* Exposure to latest tools and AI-driven analytics

* Long-term growth opportunities

* Batch timings are generally scheduled across morning and evening slots.

* This is a full-time position, and candidates are expected to be available throughout the day. Parallel commitments with other organizations will not be permitted.

* Salary increments will be completely performance-based.

* Selected candidates will be required to sign a minimum service bond of 2 years.

If you are comfortable with the above terms and looking for a long-term opportunity in training and mentoring aspiring data professionals, we would be glad to connect with you.

  • SQL: 1 year (Preferred)
  • Python: 1 year (Preferred)

Location:

  • Nagpur, Maharashtra (Nagpur) (Preferred)

When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What you will be doing...

At Verizon, we aren't just building a world-class Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) organization—we are fundamentally redefining the future of finance. As we step into the AI era, we are pioneering intelligent, AI-driven FP&A practices that will completely transform how finance teams operate and deliver strategic value. Through a comprehensive initiative to streamline processes, modernize our systems, and invest heavily in the continuous growth of our people, we are setting the industry standard. This is your opportunity to be the catalyst for this AI-powered revolution, helping us make Verizon the ultimate destination for forward-thinking FP&A professionals.

Move beyond compiling data and help tell the story behind the numbers. The Corporate FP&A positions offer opportunities to drive better business partnering and insights while developing your skill set and leadership as we continue to grow as a world-class organization. You are a valuable business partner, finding new and better ways of working by leveraging digital and AI capabilities. You’ll become involved in planning, reporting, analyses, and initiatives that will impact important decisions around the growth and development of Verizon's business. In our department, you will:

  • Architect Intelligent Workflows: Identify bottlenecks in traditional FP&A processes (like month-end close or manual data consolidation) and spearhead the implementation of automations and AI solutions.

  • AI-Enhanced Data Storytelling: Transform complex, multi-layered datasets into clear, actionable intelligence using advanced data visualization tools and AI-generated insights.

  • Bridge Finance and Technology: Act as the crucial link between traditional FP&A and data science teams, ensuring AI algorithms are trained with deep financial context and commercial acumen

  • Prompt Engineering for Finance: Utilize generative AI tools to rapidly synthesize financial data, draft preliminary variance narratives, and accelerate the reporting cycle.

  • Ensure timely and accurate delivery of financial planning, reporting & analyses for the business.

  • Be a trusted advisor by providing valuable decision support and guidance to FP&A Business Partners.

  • Proactive Value Creation: Move beyond retrospective reporting to become a forward-looking strategic advisor, using AI-driven scenario planning to guide executive decision-making and identify growth opportunities.

  • Actively participate in the cultural and professional development of Corporate FP&A as a world-class organization through Mentor/Mentee relationships and various activities offered.

  • Be the Impetus for Change: Champion the adoption of AI and modern finance practices across the broader Verizon team, overcoming resistance to change through education and proven results.

As part of the Corporate FP&A team, you will be helping the reporting and accounting teams deliver world-class, zero-touch automated solutions for all Verizon entities. You will interact with finance teams across the business, bringing new automated and AI-driven solutions to life for our month-end financial close and reporting activities.

Reporting, Automation & Data Visualization:

  • Deliver best-in-class end-to-end automated solutions for our stakeholders to support Finance Business Units (BUs) and drive efficiencies.

  • Design data visualizations of financial statements for different organizations across Verizon.

  • Deliver C-Suite Executive reporting with 100% quality and accuracy.

  • Collaborate with the various stakeholders to deploy Qlik/ Looker Applications in production environments and resolve any production issues with existing applications.

  • Document processes to ensure accuracy across the enterprise and maintain strict change control.

AI & Analytics Systems Architecture:

  • Design and build AI solutions that interact with development tools, codebases, and team workflows in meaningful ways.

  • Work extensively with LLM APIs (Claude, Gemini, Codex, and others) to understand their capabilities, limitations, and optimal application patterns for financial automation.

  • Own the developer experience of agentic interactions—making complex AI capabilities feel natural and trustworthy for finance end-users.

  • Lead technical decision-making on agent patterns, model selection, and integration approaches.

What we’re looking for…

You are a strong collaborator who can effectively own and prioritize multiple work streams and adapt during pressured situations. You display initiative and resourcefulness but are also comfortable brainstorming and sharing ideas in a team environment. You possess excellent communication skills and can partner effectively across multiple business and finance teams to speak to both internal and external stakeholders. You are adaptable to change, meet tight deadlines, and are strongly focused on the quality of your deliverables.

You'll need to have:

  • Bachelor’s degree and Four or more years of work experience in financial report automations.

  • Five or more years of relevant work experience in Business Intelligence/Analytics within FP&A teams (but not limited to this function).

  • Deep, hands-on experience building AI agents or agentic systems in production.

  • Strong understanding of LLM capabilities and limitations across multiple models (Claude, Gemini, Codex, etc.).

  • Expertise in prompt engineering, model selection, and working with tool-use/function calling.

  • Ability to mine, extract, transform, and load large financial datasets to create zero-touch reports.

  • Working knowledge of report automation tools, technologies, and end-to-end ETL processes (e.g., Knime Analytics Platform, Alteryx).

  • Experience with Qlik Sense and QVD generations from different data sources.

  • Experience in Essbase, SQL, and SQL performance tuning.

  • Knowledge of Google Suite, database management systems, and ticketing tools (e.g., Jira).

Even better if you have one or more of the following:

  • Familiarity with evaluation frameworks for agentic systems and understanding of the practical tradeoffs in production.

  • Basic knowledge of programming languages essential for modern data and AI work (e.g., Python, Google App Scripting, React.js, etc.,).

  • Background in developer tools, productivity platforms, or engineering analytics.

  • Experience with Looker, LookML will be an added advantage

  • Vizlib and NPrinting experience in Qlik Sense.

  • Exposure to GCP Big Query and Teradata databases.

  • A proven ability to derive insights from data and recommend actionable business strategies.

Where you'll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.

JOB DESCRIPTION


Wealth Management (WM) Investment Risk & Analytics (IR&A) is responsible for the risk oversight of the Managed Strategies from end to end across the WM's Private Bank and Consumer Bank businesses. Managed Strategies included JPMorgan's own proprietary products and third-party funds to include registered funds, exchange traded notes (ETNs), exchange traded funds (ETFs), separately managed accounts, hedge funds, and private equity and real estate funds, etc.

We are looking for individuals who can partner with senior members of our team to oversee business activities, models and methodologies related to investment risk. with an emphasis on developing new tools and methodologies that will aid in risk quantification.

Job responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and deploy advanced AI/ML models to derive actionable insights, automate processes, and facilitate strategic decision-making across various business units.
  • Collaborate with teams to design and oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of AI/ML initiatives – from problem scoping, data engineering, model development, validation, deployment, to monitoring.
  • Lead the model development process, including tasks such as data wrangling/analysis, model training, testing, and selection.
  • Conduct risk modeling, scenario analysis, and business impact evaluations to ensure AI/ML solutions are robust, ethical, and aligned with organizational goals.
  • Drive experimentation with advanced techniques such as deep learning, generative AI (e.g., LLMs, GANs), and reinforcement learning to solve complex business challenges and create value.
  • Collaborate with Technology on model testing, implementation, and production.
  • Deliver written, visual, and oral presentation of modeling results to business and technical stakeholders.
  • Stay abreast of emerging trends and research in AI and machine learning, and assess their potential application within the organization.
  • Represent risk analytics in governance forums, risk committees, and audit discussions.
  • Participate in regulatory and validation exams by providing documentation and responses to regulators and internal validators.
  • Partner with non-credit risk groups to identify and understand the simultaneous impact of multiple risks, such as product, fiduciary, counterparty, concentration, ESG/climate, liquidity, and their effect on investments.

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in data science, machine learning, or AI.
  • Bachelors/Master/PhD degree in Computer Science / Data Science / Mathematics / Statistics / relevant STEM field is highly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience with generative AI technologies such as transformers, large language models, or diffusion models.
  • Knowledge of key concepts in Statistics and Mathematics such as Statistical methods for Machine learning (e.g., ensemble methods, NLP, time-series), Probability Theory and Linear Algebra.
  • Have experience with investment products including fixed income, equity, and mutual funds.
  • Programming skills in Python and knowledge of common numerical and machine-learning packages (like NumPy, scikit-learn, pandas, PyTorch, LangChain, LangGraph etc.).
  • Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar.
  • Logical thought process, ability to scope out an open-ended problem into data driven solution.
  • Strong quantitative and analytical skills and ability to work with diverse cultures in a global team.
ABOUT US


JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.




ABOUT THE TEAM

J.P. Morgan Asset & Wealth Management delivers industry-leading investment management and private banking solutions. Asset Management provides individuals, advisors and institutions with strategies and expertise that span the full spectrum of asset classes through our global network of investment professionals. Wealth Management helps individuals, families and foundations take a more intentional approach to their wealth or finances to better define, focus and realize their goals.

About TE Connectivity & the Channel BU

TE Connectivity is a global technology leader that designs and manufactures connectivity and sensor solutions, serving industries that are transforming the future. The Channel Business Unit (CBU) manages TE's global distribution network and plays a critical role in driving growth, enhancing customer experience, and enabling commercial excellence across 300+ distributor partners worldwide. Channel BU brings together Sales Enablement, Marketing, Pricing, Customer Service, Digital, and PMO functions to accelerate revenue, deliver digitally enabled experiences, and achieve above-market growth.


Role Definition

We are seeking a dynamic and results-oriented Project Manager, Data & Analytics to drive the planning, execution, and delivery of strategic data and analytics initiatives supporting the Channel Business Unit. This role is responsible for orchestrating cross-functional projects across three critical pillars: Channel Data Management, Analytics Products (dashboards, self-service BI, reporting), and AI / Data Science Products (predictive models, NLP, agentic AI solutions).

The ideal candidate is a strong project leader and influencer who thrives in matrixed, global environments, someone who can align diverse stakeholders across geographies, drive accountability without direct authority, and ensure complex data & analytics programs are delivered on time, within scope, and with measurable business impact. This role requires exceptional communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills to navigate competing priorities and secure buy-in from senior leaders, technical teams, and business partners alike.

Based in Bangalore, India, this role will partner closely with the NA-based Data & Analytics product owner, the India-based Data Analytics & Data Science Delivery Manager, India-based Data & Analytics team, Channel BU leadership, global DIA teams, and cross-functional stakeholders across AMER, EMEA, and APAC regions.

Job Requirements

Project Planning & Delivery

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of the Channel BU Data & Analytics portfolio, including project scoping, planning, resource allocation, risk management, and execution.
  • Maintain integrated roadmaps across Data Management, Analytics, and AI/Data Science initiatives, ensuring alignment with business priorities and delivery commitments.
  • Apply Agile and hybrid delivery methodologies to drive predictable, high-quality outcomes.
  • Manage risks, dependencies, and issues, defining mitigation plans and escalating where appropriate.
  • Monitor scope, schedule, budget, and quality through dashboards and executive reporting.
  • Coordinate release, change, and deployment activities to ensure seamless implementation.

Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Management

  • Act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, delivery teams, and enterprise platform teams.
  • Influence senior leaders and functional partners to align priorities, secure resources, and gain agreement on scope and timelines.
  • Facilitate workshops and requirements-gathering sessions to ensure solutions meet business objectives and adoption goals.
  • Provide strategic input on portfolio prioritization, capacity planning, and investment decisions.
  • Build strong relationships with stakeholders across AMER, EMEA, and APAC, driving collaboration in a global matrix environment.
  • Lead change management and communication activities to support adoption of analytics and AI solutions.

Portfolio Governance & Demand Management

  • Establish and manage demand intake and prioritization processes, ensuring resources are allocated to the highest-value initiatives.
  • Drive portfolio governance through stage-gate reviews, investment tracking, and value realization reporting.
  • Track and communicate business impact, including financial value, efficiency gains, and adoption metrics.
  • Manage project budgets and external vendor engagements where applicable.
  • Maintain project documentation, best practices, and lessons learned to support continuous improvement and delivery excellence.

Data & Analytics Program Support

  • Support enterprise data platform and analytics transformations, including Databricks adoption, legacy system retirement, and BI platform migrations.
  • Coordinate AI/ML and data science initiatives from ideation through deployment, ensuring compliance with enterprise governance, privacy, and regulatory standards.
  • Partner with analytics delivery leaders to align project demand, team capacity, and resource utilization.
  • Drive Data & AI literacy through training, onboarding, and user engagement programs.
  • Support development of business cases, ROI assessments, effort estimates, and stakeholder alignment for new analytics and AI initiatives.

What your background should look like

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or related field.
  • 8+ years of progressive experience in project management, program management, or delivery management within data analytics, business intelligence, data engineering, or technology domains.
  • 5+ years of experience managing complex, cross-functional projects in matrixed, global organizations with geographically distributed teams.
  • PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, SAFe, or equivalent Agile/project management certification strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience managing data & analytics or AI/ML projects, including familiarity with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau), cloud data platforms (Databricks, Azure, AWS), and modern data architectures.
  • Strong understanding of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) and hybrid delivery frameworks; experience with project management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Planisware, or Microsoft Project.
  • Experience with vendor management, SOW/contract oversight, and budget management for technology projects.
  • Familiarity with data warehousing concepts, ETL/ELT processes, and enterprise data governance is a strong plus.

Ideal Soft Skills

Influence & Negotiation: Exceptional ability to influence without authority, negotiate priorities, build coalitions, and drive alignment across senior leaders, technical teams, and business partners in a global matrixed environment. Proven track record of securing stakeholder buy-in and resolving conflicts through diplomacy and persuasion.

Business Acumen: Ability to understand business context and translate Channel BU priorities into well-scoped, high-impact data & analytics projects. Experience in Channel/Distribution business models is a strong plus.

Delivery Management: Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and workstreams, balance competing priorities, and deliver on committed timelines using Agile and hybrid methodologies with operational rigor.

Leadership & Collaboration: Strong servant-leadership mindset with the ability to motivate cross-functional teams, foster accountability, and build a culture of trust and collaboration across geographies and time zones.

Communication & Storytelling: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; ability to present project status, risks, and recommendations to executive audiences with clarity and confidence. Skilled at tailoring messaging for diverse audiences.

Change Management: Experience driving organizational change, platform migrations, process improvements, and adoption of new tools and ways of working.

Analytical Thinking: Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to synthesize complex information, identify patterns, and make data-driven recommendations to improve project outcomes and portfolio performance.

Competencies

SET : Strategy, Execution, Talent (for managers)

Bangalore, Karnātaka 560076
India

description_html:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What you will be doing...

At Verizon, we aren't just building a world-class Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) organization, we are fundamentally redefining the future of finance. As we step into the AI era, we are pioneering intelligent, AI-driven FP&A practices that will completely transform how finance teams operate and deliver strategic value. Through a comprehensive initiative to streamline processes, modernize our systems, and invest heavily in the continuous growth of our people, we are setting the industry standard. This is your opportunity to be a driver of this AI-powered revolution, making Verizon the ultimate destination for forward-thinking FP&A professionals.

Move beyond compiling data and help tell the story behind the numbers. The Corporate FP&A positions offer opportunities to drive better business partnering and insights while developing your skill set and career as we continue to grow as a world-class organization. You are a valuable business partner, finding new and better ways of working by leveraging digital and AI capabilities. You’ll become involved in planning, reporting, analyses, and initiatives that will impact important decisions around the growth and development of Verizon's business. In our department, you will:

  • Build and Maintain Intelligent Workflows: Identify bottlenecks in traditional FP&A processes (like month-end close or manual data consolidation) and support the implementation of automations and AI solutions.

  • AI-Enhanced Data Storytelling: Transform complex, multi-layered datasets into clear, actionable intelligence using data visualization tools and AI-generated insights.

  • Connect Finance and Technology: Help bridge the gap between traditional FP&A and data science teams, assisting in data preparation so AI algorithms are trained with deep financial context.

  • Prompt Engineering for Finance: Utilize generative AI tools to rapidly synthesize financial data, draft preliminary variance narratives, and accelerate the reporting cycle.

  • Ensure timely and accurate delivery of financial planning, reporting & analyses for the business.

  • Support Decision-Making: Provide reliable data support and analytical guidance to FP&A Business Partners.

  • Data-Driven Value Creation: Move beyond retrospective reporting to assist in forward-looking planning, utilizing AI-driven scenario models to support executive decision-making.

  • Actively participate in the cultural and professional development of Corporate FP&A as a world-class organization through Mentor/Mentee relationships and various activities offered.

  • Embrace Change: Adopt and champion AI and modern finance practices within your daily workflows, helping the broader Verizon team see the proven results of automation.

As part of the Corporate FP&A team, you will be helping the reporting and accounting teams deliver world-class, zero-touch automated solutions for all Verizon entities. You will interact with finance teams across the business, helping bring new automated and AI-driven solutions to life for our month-end financial close and reporting activities.

Reporting, Automation & Data Visualization:

  • Develop end-to-end automated solutions for our stakeholders to support Finance Business Units (BUs) and drive efficiencies.

  • Build and design data visualizations of financial statements for different organizations across Verizon.

  • Assist in preparation of C-Suite Executive reporting with 100% quality and accuracy.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to maintain Qlik/ Looker Applications in production environments and resolve any production issues with existing applications.

  • Document processes to ensure accuracy across the enterprise and maintain strict change control.

AI & Analytics Systems Development:

  • Develop and test AI solutions that interact with development tools, codebases, and team workflows.

  • Work with LLM APIs (Claude, Gemini, Codex, and others) to understand their capabilities, limitations, and practical application for financial automation.

  • Support the end-user experience of agentic interactions—ensuring complex AI capabilities feel natural and trustworthy for finance teams.

  • Contribute to technical discussions regarding agent patterns, model selection, and integration approaches.

What we’re looking for…

You are a strong collaborator who can effectively manage and prioritize multiple tasks and adapt during pressured situations. You display initiative and resourcefulness but are also comfortable brainstorming and sharing ideas in a team environment. You possess excellent communication skills and can partner effectively across multiple business and finance teams. You are adaptable to change, meet tight deadlines, and are strongly focused on the quality of your deliverables.

You'll need to have:

  • Bachelor’s degree and one or more years of work experience in financial report automations, business intelligence, or data analytics.

  • Hands-on experience or strong academic exposure to building/utilizing AI tools, prompts, or workflows.

  • Understanding of LLM capabilities and limitations across multiple models (Claude, Gemini, Codex, etc.).

  • Familiarity with prompt engineering and working with tool-use/function calling.

  • Ability to mine, extract, transform, and load large financial datasets to create automated reports.

  • Working knowledge of report automation tools, technologies, and end-to-end ETL processes (e.g., Knime Analytics Platform, Alteryx).

  • Experience with Qlik Sense, Looker, or similar visualization tools.

  • Basic knowledge of SQL and database queries.

  • Knowledge of Google Suite and ticketing tools (e.g., Jira).

Even better if you have one or more of the following:

  • Familiarity with Python or Google App Scripting for modern data and AI workflows.

  • Experience with Essbase and SQL performance tuning.

  • Familiarity with evaluation frameworks for agentic systems.

  • Vizlib and NPrinting experience in Qlik Sense.

  • Exposure to GCP Big Query or Teradata databases.

  • A proven ability to derive insights from data and recommend actionable business strategies.

Where you'll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.

description_html:
TE Connectivity is a global technology leader that designs and manufactures connectivity and sensor solutions, serving industries that are transforming the future. The Channel Business Unit (CBU) manages TE’s global distribution network and plays a critical role in driving growth, enhancing customer experience, and enabling commercial excellence across 300+ distributor partners worldwide. Channel BU brings together Sales Enablement, Marketing, Pricing, Customer Service, Digital, and PMO functions to accelerate revenue, deliver digitally enabled experiences, and achieve above-market growth.


Role Definition

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Data Analytics & Data Science Delivery Manager to lead and grow our India-based analytics team supporting the Channel Business Unit. This role is accountable for end-to-end delivery across three critical pillars: Channel Data Management, Analytics Products (dashboards, self-service BI, reporting), and AI / Data Science Products (predictive models, NLP, machine learning solutions).

The ideal candidate combines strong people leadership with deep technical fluency, someone who can manage a team of 8–12 BI developers, analytics engineers, and data scientists while also rolling up their sleeves to architect solutions, shape demand with business stakeholders, and drive adoption of enterprise data platforms. This role operates at the intersection of business strategy and technical execution, ensuring the Channel BU leverages data as a strategic asset for growth, efficiency, and innovation.

Based in Bangalore, India, this role will partner closely with the NA based Data & Analytics product owner, Channel BU leadership, global DIA teams, and cross-functional stakeholders across AMER, EMEA, and APAC regions.

Tasks and responsibilities

Team Leadership & Delivery

  • Lead and develop a team of 8–12 analytics engineers, data engineers, and data scientists.
  • Own delivery of the Channel BU analytics portfolio, including capacity planning, backlog prioritization, sprint execution, and roadmap commitments.
  • Establish Agile practices and drive predictable, high-quality delivery.
  • Manage performance through goal setting, coaching, development planning, and succession planning.
  • Support hiring, onboarding, retention, and growth of India-based analytics talent.
  • Foster a culture of ownership, innovation, continuous learning, and operational excellence.
  • Drive KPI, SLA, QBR, and continuous improvement initiatives, ensuring effective issue resolution and operational maturity.

Channel Data Management

  • Define and execute the Channel BU data and analytics roadmap.
  • Oversee development and maintenance of data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, and data models supporting POS, inventory, backlog, pricing, and solution center analytics.
  • Manage Databricks architecture, including dimensional modeling and scalable data-loading strategies.
  • Ensure data quality, governance, security, lineage, and compliance in partnership with enterprise teams.
  • Lead migration from legacy platforms to the OneData Platform (Databricks), eliminating duplication and ensuring business continuity.

Analytics & Self-Service BI

  • Deliver dashboards, analytics solutions, and AI-powered tools for leadership, sales, customer care, pricing, and strategy teams.
  • Build scalable semantic models and self-service analytics capabilities using Power BI and related technologies.
  • Ensure governed analytics through security controls, metadata management, and version control.
  • Translate data into actionable insights and continuously improve solution adoption, performance, and user experience.

AI & Data Science

  • Lead development and deployment of AI/ML solutions, including forecasting, customer segmentation, pricing intelligence, data optimization, and automation use cases.
  • Partner with business and AI leaders to identify opportunities, build business cases, and deliver measurable value.
  • Oversee the full data science lifecycle from problem definition through deployment and monitoring.
  • Ensure compliance with enterprise standards for AI governance, ethics, privacy, and regulatory requirements.

Stakeholder Management

  • Act as the primary analytics partner for Channel BU, aligning priorities and communicating delivery progress.
  • Translate business needs into scalable analytics and AI solutions in collaboration with stakeholders, process owners, and the broader DIA organization.
  • Establish demand management processes and track business value delivered.
  • Promote Data & AI literacy and self-service adoption across the organization.
  • Collaborate effectively with global stakeholders across AMER, EMEA, and APAC.

What your background should look like

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering (BE/BTech), Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or related quantitative field. Master's degree preferred.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data engineering, or data science roles.
  • 3+ years of direct people management experience leading teams of 5+ resources, with a proven track record of building and developing high-performing analytics teams.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau) including dashboard design, semantic data modeling, and performance optimization.
  • 3+ years of experience with cloud data platforms (AWS Redshift, S3, Databricks, Azure) and modern data warehouse architectures.
  • 2+ years of experience with Python, R, or similar languages for data analysis, automation, and/or machine learning.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering AI/ML or data science projects from ideation through production deployment.
  • Strong SQL skills and deep understanding of data warehousing concepts (star/snowflake schemas, ETL/ELT, incremental loading).

Ideal Soft Skills

  • Business Acumen: Ability to translate business needs into data-driven strategies and deliver measurable impact. Experience in Channel/Distribution business models is a strong plus.
  • Delivery Management: Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams, balance competing priorities, and deliver on committed timelines using Agile methodologies.
  • Leadership & Influence: Strong ability to engage, communicate, and influence senior executives and cross-functional teams across geographies and time zones.
  • Technical Depth: Hands-on fluency with modern data stack — data engineering, analytics, and data science — sufficient to guide architecture decisions, conduct code reviews, and unblock the team.
  • Change Management: Experience driving organizational change, legacy system modernization, platform migration, and data literacy initiatives.
  • Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; ability to present complex analytical findings to executive audiences through data storytelling.

Technical background

  • Data Platforms: Databricks, AWS S3, Azure, Snowflake with deep understanding of star/snowflake schemas, fact/dimension tables, and data warehousing concepts
  • ETL/ELT & Orchestration: Azure Data Factory, AWS Glue, dbt, Apache Airflow, or similar pipeline orchestration tools
  • Data Governance: Data lineage, cataloging, quality frameworks, and metadata management
  • BI Tools: Power BI (DAX, Power Query, semantic models, row-level security) and Tableau (LOD expressions, Tableau Prep, Tableau Server/Cloud)
  • Data Modeling: Semantic model design, star/snowflake schema optimization, incremental refresh strategies
  • ML Platforms: Databricks MLflow, AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, or similar
  • Generative AI: Familiarity with Microsoft Copilot, Databricks AI/Genie, Salesforce Einstein, LLM-based solutions, and prompt engineering

Competencies

SET : Strategy, Execution, Talent (for managers)

Bangalore, Karnātaka 560076

Job Summary

Responsible for collaborating with business partners and identifying business problems. Recommend solutions with new or existing processes, applications, systems, programs, or software. Will manage and drive multiple primary assignments and handle complex issues/requests. Will act as the primary contact as a business relationship manager that will become a subject matter expert in operations data for Safety, People, Quality, Service, or Cost.

Job Description

Business Analyst Responsibilities :

  • Supports requirements gathering and discovery workshops with our business stakeholders.
  • Conducts current state assessments of business processes and supporting systems.
  • Performs gap and data analysis in support of identifying improvement opportunities.
  • Supports Technical Leads and developers by providing functional clarification and setting expectations with team and business.
  • Documents socializes, and triages issues, defects, and enhancement requests.
  • Elicit and document requirements, and creates logical system specifications and/or wireframes, change requests, test cases, user guides, training materials, and strategy roadmaps.
  • Create process/data flows to create a visual representation of requirements
  • Executing test cases and ensuring the overall quality of the solution is a plus.
  • Perform System configurations
  • Independently identify, research, and resolve open design questions
  • Provide functional and technical support for production systems

Scrum Master Responsibilities

  • Facilitate the team's Scrum ceremonies, i.e. Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Sprint Review, Sprint Retrospective, Backlog grooming.
  • Liaise with the Product Owner and the Business Analysts in order to ensure completeness and clarity of user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Guiding the team on how to get the most of out of self-organization.
  • Guiding the team on the Agile Scrum methodology in order to constantly improve the Scrum team's standards of work.
  • Managing relationships and communicating with the project sponsor, senior management and other project contributors
  • Assisting with internal and external communication, improving transparency, and radiating information
  • Removing impediments or guiding the team to remove impediments by finding the right personnel to remove the impediment.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvements and drive those from idea to implementation.

Work Experience and Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree related to Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or Information Technology from an accredited university
  • 6-8 + years of experience related to Business Analyst / Scrum Master or Technical Analyst within an IT technology environment
  • Understand the path to purchase and flow of data between systems in an e-commerce environment
  • Hands-on experience working on Enterprise e-commerce applications.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, both verbal and written
  • Technical understanding of complex Enterprise Web and Mobile Application development and deployment concepts
  • Experience in an Agile Environment (using Jira, Confluence)
  • Ability to solve problems, identify solutions, and appropriately escalate issues
  • Excels at operating in a fast-paced technical environment
  • Proficient with SQL
  • Understand the fundamentals of DevOps/Continuous Delivery Pipeline.
  • Some development in Java, HTML, and Javascript
  • Experience in working onshore-offshore model/Global teams.
  • Work experience in ecommerce domain is a plus
  • Experience working with Oracle Web Commerce (ATG / Endeca/BoomReach) is a big plus.
  • Excellent computer skills and proficiency in Visio, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook

  • Educational Qualification:

  • Bachelor’s degree related to Computer Science, Information Systems, Business or Information Technology from an accredited university

  • Assist in creating user stories for the sprint
  • Assist the Business Team with UAT testing of the stories
  • Facilitate sprint grooming meetings with the project team
  • Participate with Product Owner and Product Grooming processes.

About Medline India:
Medline India was setup in 2010 in Pune, primarily as an offshore Development centre and to augment resources for Medline Industries LP headquartered in Chicago, USA. We are a 1500+ strong and growing team of technology, finance & and business support professionals who support our businesses worldwide towards a mission to make healthcare run better. We are proud to be certified as a ‘Great Place to Work’ by the Great Place to Work Institute® (India) for the duration May 2023 – May 2024.
We are an organization with a conducive work environment, ample opportunities to learn, contribute and grow with a highly empowered & engaged team. We encourage our people to share their best ideas and create new opportunities for our customers and ourselves to work together to solve today’s toughest healthcare challenges.
About Medline Industries, LP:
Established in 1966, Medline Industries LP is a renowned global healthcare organization boasting 56 years of consecutive sales growth, exceeding $21 billion in annual sales. With a workforce of over 36,000 professionals spread across the globe, we operate in more than 125 countries and territories. As the largest privately held manufacturer and distributor of medical supplies in the United States, Medline is uniquely positioned to offer comprehensive products, education, and support across the continuum of care.
At present, Medline Industries, LP holds the esteemed position as the #1 market leader, delivering an extensive portfolio of over 550,000 medical products and clinical solutions. Our clientele includes hospitals, extended care facilities, surgery centres, physician offices, home care agencies, providers, and retailers. We are proud to be recognized by Forbes as one of America’s Best Large Employers and Best Employers for Women. Additionally, the Chicago Tribune has consistently named us a Top Workplace for the past 12 years.
