JOLLY CLAMPS PVT. LTD.

Manufacturers of Steel Clamps & Couplings

JOB DESCRIPTION

Position

Automation & Data Analyst (Manufacturing Operations)

Department

Automation & Systems

Location

Goregaon (Head Office) + Virar (Factory) — travel between both required

Experience

1–2 years

Reports To

Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

Employment

Full-time, on-site

About the Role

Jolly Clamps Pvt. Ltd. (JCPL) is building in-house capability to automate its manufacturing operations and bring its inventory, work-in-progress (WIP) and costing data under tight, reliable control. This is a hands-on role for someone in their career who wants to excel in how a real manufacturing business runs and turn its day-to-day data into dependable dashboards, reports and small applications.

You will work closely with the Chief Financial Officer (CFO), the operations and information technology (IT) teams, and the shop floor across both the Goregaon head office and the Virar factory. Full training and mentoring will be provided; what matters most is a genuine appetite to learn, attention to detail, and comfort working with data.

Core principles you will be trained to follow:

  • rely on a single, agreed source of data rather than scattered reports;
  • use clear, deterministic (rule-based) computation that anyone can audit, with no guesswork;
  • always validate a solution on one test case before scaling it across the plant.

Key Responsibilities

Under the guidance of the CFO and senior team members, you will support, build and maintain the following. You are not expected to do all of this on day one — you will be brought up to speed project by project.

Production Planning & Control (PPC) — Python-based Planning Solutions

A central part of the role is helping build and run a suite of Python-based tools that turn the monthly Sales forecast into a realistic, committed production plan. Working with the planning and operations teams, you will support:

  • Planning engine (demand to commitment): Build and maintain the monthly planning engine that converts the Sales forecast (received item-wise and family-wise from the enterprise resource planning system) into a deliverable commitment, running demand against line capacity, manpower and material limits to produce the family-wise quantity committed to Sales.
  • Forecast cleanup & common-part master: Automate cleanup and filtration of the location-wise forecast by grouping stock-keeping units (SKUs) that share a common internal part code into a single common part, replacing the manual pivot; create and maintain the master that maps customer and location SKUs to the common-part code.
  • Capacity, manpower & occupancy model: Automate the family-wise line-capacity and manpower model to compute shift-wise occupancy percentage, flag demand exceeding both shifts as over-capacity, and base commitments on current manpower, allowing for the recruitment lead time.
  • Economic batch quantity batching: Hold the economic batch quantity (EBQ) per item as a clean master and build batching logic that defaults to it, quantifying the efficiency loss when priority orders break the batch and trigger extra changeovers.
  • Make-to-stock stock-level prioritisation: Automate the colour-coded make-to-stock , stock-level sheet and auto-sequence production so the most critical parts are made first, replacing the heavy manual spreadsheet.
  • Trading-conversion & excess-production traceability: Build logic that traces production booked against a common part, the trading-conversion transfers to individual customer codes and the residual balance, so excess production is attributed to the Sales order that drove it and made visible to Sales.
  • Demand cadence by customer type: Encode the differing demand cadences by customer type (aftermarket weekly; regular original-equipment-manufacturer customers on a weekly cycle; trigger-based customers daily) into the plan, along with the buffer and overtime catch-up mechanism used to meet the required daily rate.
  • Material requirement planning: Extend the planning engine to derive raw-material and child-part requirements from the committed family and item plan and batch quantities, so procurement is driven by the confirmed plan and checked against stock and open purchase orders.

Data Reconciliation & Control Reports (rule-based, auditable)

  • Daily inventory reconciliation reports (opening stock plus purchases, less consumption, equals closing stock; and finished goods produced versus dispatched).
  • Material-balance checks that reconcile input against output, scrap and work-in-progress (WIP) movement, allowing for normal process weight and measurement tolerances.
  • Consumption-based costing reports that value material on actual usage rather than purchases, organised by cost centre.
  • Reclassification of items between make-to-stock and make-to-order based on demand trends.
  • Exception and error-tracking reports that flag wrong, reversed, delayed or duplicate transactions, along with their likely cause.
  • Threshold-based monitoring (for example, inventory or work-in-progress above an agreed reference level) with automatic alert notifications.

Workflow Automation

  • Help set up the scheduled extraction of system reports, with automatic pickup and processing into daily reconciliations.
  • Support automated report extraction through application programming interfaces (API) feeding business intelligence (BI) dashboards.
  • Assist in consolidating overlapping automation tools onto a single, governed workflow platform.

Data-Capture Applications & Dashboards

  • Support data-capture applications that record activity at source (plan versus actual, productivity, adherence), with a database behind them and a link to the enterprise resource planning (ERP) system.
  • Help deploy point-of-source data capture using fixed screens or tablets feeding a central database and live dashboards.

System Controls (with the IT team)

  • Help implement controls that prevent item, grade or master-data mismatch, with daily exception reporting.
  • Support duplicate-entry prevention using unique transaction identifiers and a holding area for failed entries.
  • Assist in evaluating a warehouse management system (WMS) and its integration with the ERP.

General

  • Validate every report and tool against real data before it is relied upon.
  • Document what you build so others can understand and maintain it.
  • Coordinate with stores, shop-floor, accounts and IT colleagues to keep data accurate and on time.

Skills & Knowledge

Essential (foundational level is acceptable for a fresher)

  • Python,N8N,Replit,Cursor,Java : Working knowledge of Python,N8N,Replit,Cursor,Java for data handling, building planning and reconciliation logic, and simple automation.
  • Data / spreadsheets: Comfort with spreadsheets, formulas and structured data; willingness to learn Power Query and business intelligence (BI) tools such as Power BI.
  • Databases: Basic understanding of databases and the ability to write simple structured query language (SQL) queries.
  • Logic & accuracy: Strong attention to detail and a logical, methodical approach to problem-solving.
  • Communication: Clear written and spoken communication, able to explain a number or a report simply.

Desirable (a plus, not required — training will be given)

  • Automation tools: Exposure to a workflow automation platform (for example, low-code or no-code tools).
  • App building: Any experience building small web pages, dashboards or applications.
  • ERP / systems: Familiarity with an enterprise resource planning (ERP) system or how factory data is recorded.
  • Programming: Basic Java or any second programming language.
  • Domain interest: Curiosity about manufacturing, production planning, inventory, costing and operations.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, data, commerce or a related field; or equivalent demonstrated ability.
  • Graduates with relevant projects, internships or self-built work (for example, dashboards, small applications or automations) are encouraged to apply.
  • Practical evidence of your work — a portfolio, project links or samples — is valued alongside formal qualifications.

What the Role Offers

  • Direct mentoring from the Chief Financial Officer (CFO) and senior operations and finance leaders.
  • Real ownership of meaningful projects on a live factory floor, not theoretical exercises.
  • Broad exposure across finance, operations, inventory, costing and information technology in one role.
  • A clear path to grow into a specialist automation, data or systems position as you develop.

Please mention your willingness to travel between the Goregaon office and the Virar factory.

Pay: ₹400,000.00 - ₹700,000.00 per year

Benefits:

  • Paid sick time
  • Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

Supply Chain O2C Analyst - Customer Fulfilment

Category: Supply Chain
Location: Bangalore, Karnataka, IN
Title: Supply Chain O2C Analyst - Customer Fulfilment
Company: Novo Nordisk Global Business Services (GBS)
Department: Operations GBS

Are you ready to own the full order lifecycle for a company whose products reach millions of patients every day? Do you thrive on turning complexity into seamless customer experiences? Then this could be your next role at Novo Nordisk. Read on and apply today for a life-changing career.

Your new role
As an Order to Cash (O2C) Analyst based in our Bangalore Global Business Services centre, you will manage the end-to-end order lifecycle – from capture and validation through fulfilment, invoicing and dispute resolution – ensuring accurate, on-time delivery for our customers around the world. You will partner cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Service, Planning, Logistics, Finance and Master Data teams to drive order accuracy and elevate the customer experience.

Your key responsibilities will include:
  • Order management & fulfilment: Validate incoming orders (pricing, terms, credit, SKU, quantity, delivery windows, compliance documentation), coordinate order promising and quality checks with Planning, Logistics and Master Data, and proactively monitor status to escalate risks such as shortages or delays and drive resolution.
  • Billing & invoicing: Ensure accurate billing (price, discounts, taxes, freight, surcharges, rebates) and timely invoice generation; reconcile stocks and EDI/portal invoices; manage corrections, credit notes and debit notes; and resolve failures in partnership with relevant departments.
  • Customer experience & stakeholder management: Serve as the O2C point of contact for key accounts and own SLA adherence, including OTIF (On Time In Full) performance.
  • Controls, compliance & data quality: Maintain master data hygiene across customer, materials, pricing and tax codes, and adhere to internal controls (SOX/IFC), audit requirements and documentation standards.
  • Continuous improvement & analytics: Track and analyse O2C KPIs, perform root cause analysis, lead Kaizen projects, and contribute to process automation (RPA/Power Automate), EDI enhancements and policy updates.

Your new department
You will be part of the Commercial Supply Chain Customer Fulfilment Ops team based in Bangalore. Our department is dedicated to managing the end-to-end supply chain processes, ensuring products move seamlessly from suppliers to customers. We focus on designing future supply chains, developing global, regional, and country strategies, monitoring costs, and driving improvements in processes. The team operates in a dynamic environment, where your contributions will directly impact the efficiency and success of our supply chain operations. You will be working alongside a highly collaborative O2C team that operates at the heart of Novo Nordisk's global value chain. Together, we make sure every order flows smoothly from capture to cash – so that our life-saving medicines reach the patients who depend on them, on time and without compromise.

Your skills & qualifications
We are looking for an experienced O2C professional who combines strong technical proficiency with a customer-first mindset and a bias for action. To succeed in this role, you likely bring:

  • A Graduate or Postgraduate degree, with 8+ years of experience managing the O2C value chain end-to-end.
  • Hands-on experience with ERP systems (SAP SD / S/4HANA) and familiarity with e-invoicing and e-ordering platforms.
  • Proficiency in Excel and Power BI, with working knowledge of Power Automate, UiPath or Automation Anywhere considered a strong advantage.
  • Solid understanding of internal controls (SOX/IFC), audit requirements, and master data governance, coupled with proven ability to anticipate credit, supply and compliance risks and escalate early with options.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with a track record of navigating complex internal (Supply Planning, Master Data, Finance, IT/Integration, affiliate stakeholders) and external interfaces (customers, 3PLs, carriers, auditors) with professionalism and calm.
  • Comfort with collaboration tools such as Teams, Outlook and ticketing systems (ServiceNow), and a demonstrated ability to operate with minimal supervision, close loops and document decisions.

Working at Novo Nordisk
Every day we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with determination, constant curiosity and a commitment to finding better ways forward. For over 100 years, this dedication has driven us to build a company focused on lasting change for long-term health. One where diverse thinking, shared purpose and mutual respect come together to create extraordinary results. When you join us, you're not just starting a job – you're becoming part of a story that spans generations.

What we offer
There is, of course, more on offer here than the uniqueness of our culture and the extraordinary results we produce. Being part of a global healthcare company means opportunities to learn and develop are all around us, while our benefits are designed with your career and life stage in mind.

Deadline
20th July, 2026.
We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

At Novo Nordisk, we're not chasing quick fixes – we're creating lasting change for long-term health. For over 100 years, we've been driven by a single purpose: to defeat serious chronic diseases and help millions of people live healthier lives. This dedication fuels our constant curiosity and inspires us to push the boundaries of what's possible in healthcare. We embrace diverse perspectives, seek out bold ideas, and build partnerships rooted in shared purpose. Together, we're making healthcare more accessible, treating and preventing diseases, and pioneering solutions that create change spanning generations. When you join us, you become part of something bigger – a legacy of impact that reaches far beyond today.

Controls, compliance & data quality: Maintain master data hygiene across customer, materials, pricing and tax codes, and adhere to internal controls (SOX/IFC), audit requirements and documentation standards.

The team operates in a dynamic environment, where your contributions will directly impact the efficiency and success of our supply chain operations. You will be working alongside a highly collaborative O2C team that operates at the heart of Novo Nordisk's global value chain. Together, we make sure every order flows smoothly from capture to cash – so that our life-saving medicines reach the patients who depend on them, on time and without compromise.

A Graduate or Postgraduate degree, with 8+ years of experience managing the O2C value chain end-to-end.
Hands-on experience with ERP systems (SAP SD / S/4HANA) and familiarity with e-invoicing and e-ordering platforms.
Proficiency in Excel and Power BI, with working knowledge of Power Automate, UiPath or Automation Anywhere considered a strong advantage.
Solid understanding of internal controls (SOX/IFC), audit requirements, and master data governance, coupled with proven ability to anticipate credit, supply and compliance risks and escalate early with options.

Azurity Pharmaceuticals is a privately held, specialty pharmaceutical company that focuses on innovative products that meet the needs of underserved patients. As an industry leader in providing unique, accessible, and high-quality medications, Azurity leverages its integrated capabilities and vast partner network to continually expand its broad commercial product portfolio and robust late-stage pipeline. The company's patient-centric products span the cardiovascular, neurology, endocrinology, gastro-intestinal, institutional, and orphan markets, and have benefited millions of patients. For more information, visit www.azurity.com.

Azurity Pharmaceuticals is proud to be an inclusive workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. Azurity's success is attributable to our incredibly talented, dedicated team that focuses on benefiting the lives of patients by bringing the best science and commitment to quality into everything that we do. We seek highly motivated individuals with the dedication, integrity, and creative spirit needed to thrive in our organization.

Job Description summary

The Azurity Finance Team is seeking an Analyst for the BP&A Operations team to partner with US stakeholders and drive insights across Inventory, COGS, Supply Chain, Technical Operations, and Quality Controle performance. The role offers exposure to operational finance in a dynamic, regulated environment.

Role and Responsibilities

  • Assist in building the annual operating plan (budget) for Operating Expense and Inventory Purchases.
  • Updating and maintaining monthly and quarterly Operating Expense forecasts including personnel rosters for each executive team member under the Chief Operating Officer.
  • Assist in delivering structured variance analysis (Actuals vs Budget/Forecast) with quantified drivers and actionable insights, both on a monthly and quarterly basis.
  • Assist US-based BP&A teams in Monthly Close activities, including partnering with business and Supply Chain, Technical Operation and Quality Controle teams to propose accurate accruals, record prepayments, and document fluctuations in key expense accounts.
  • Support analysis of inventory movements, ensuring alignment with Supply Chain procurement cycles and Commercial Sales forecasts, both on a monthly and quarterly basis.
  • Tracking Key Performance Indicators (Days Inventory On Hand, Excess & Obsolescence, OpEx, Standard Cost Per Unit) and providing performance insights to business partners.
  • Assist in monitoring and analyzing standard cost deviations (finished good pricing, material rate variances, foreign exchange, and sales mix), highlighting key drivers and extrapolating data trends.
  • Support that development of financial models for budgeting and forecasting, incorporating sales volumes, standard cost assumptions, and inventory procurement planning.
  • Assist in updating and maintaining standard costing and COGS calculations, including updates to Oracle based on each products bill of materials (BOM) and underlying cost assumptions.
  • Work closely with the Supply Chain team to understand production, procurement, and inventory trends.
  • Drive financial visibility in the Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) process by analyzing inventory risks (obsolescence, excess, backorders) and evaluating monthly forecast changes to support decision-making and alignment with business targets.
  • Assist in identifying and correctly recognizing CapEx components of larger Tech Transfer contracts.
  • Collaborate with Accounts Payable and Procurement to support Purchase Order tracking, and approval.
  • Support process improvements and automation initiatives across Operations BP&A, leveraging Excel, Large Language Models, Workday Adaptive Planning, and Power BI / data visualization tools.

Qualifications and Education Requirements

  • Education: CA with 5+ years of relevant experience. Pharmaceutical industry experience is a plus.
  • Experience with Oracle and Workday is preferred.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including automation techniques, along with experience in Power BI / other data visualization tools for reporting and insights.


By applying for this role, you confirm that you are mentally and physically capable of fulfilling the job responsibilities detailed in the job description without any restrictions. If you have any concerns or even the slightest disability that may affect your ability to perform the job, please inform HR in advance.

  • Leverage retail energy market knowledge to maintain strong client relationships

  • Support ad hoc analysis and operational projects as needed

  • Use AI for anomaly detection, insights generation, and workflow optimization

Process Improvement

POSITION SUMMARY

Training Analyst creates, plans, and provides training for the new product programs. They help design and develop training materials, such as lessons, assessments, and visual aids, to help associates learn and understand the material. Continually improve the knowledge, skills, and abilities of associates. Training programs may be conducted in a classroom, in a laboratory, in the production floor, or online. They also facilitate classroom discussions, run lab work, troubleshoot technical issues, and provide feedback to associates. They collaborate with stakeholders, and subject matter experts, maintaining up-to-date course content and track associate progress.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Always work with Safety, Quality and Respect in Mind. Demonstrates the VALUE in Training.
  • Create training schedules for all company departments, track and create reports on outcomes of all training and maintain training records for the company.
  • Train new hires on company policies and procedures and use the best training methods for a specific purpose or audience.
  • Gather and evaluate information from employees and management on previous training to identify weaknesses and areas that need additional training.
  • Attend seminars and meetings to learn new training methods and techniques and use the knowledge to prepare and coordinate future training sessions.
  • Recruit and train new Trainers, delegate training tasks to the new Trainers and evaluate performance.
  • Market company training opportunities to employees and provide information on benefits to encourage participation.
  • Inform employees on scheduled training and track their progress.
  • Recommend training materials and methods, order and maintain in-house training equipment and facilities and manage the budget set for training.
  • Lead a team of instructors to design, develop and deliver technical training and development programs for Vertiv Personal.
  • Develop effective working relationships with and consult with key stakeholders to support the continual gathering of information, feedback, and input from them in order drive curriculum development/evolution.
  • Design training programs to ensure training transfer on the job. This includes course pre-work, instructor lecture, hands-on lab exercises, post-work, exams, and on-the-job training plans.
  • Assist to design and develop training strategy for the organization including technical and non-technical, onboarding, refresh training, training for new products and enhancement for existing products, etc.
  • Assist trainers to develop quarterly and annual technical training calendar.
  • Implement a Train-The-Trainer certification program.
  • Establish technical skill assessment tools to build customized learning programs and curriculums to improve team performance and customer experience.
  • Develop standard work for team learning and development journey.
  • Manage technical learning centers.
  • Apply Adult Learning Theory, eLearning, blended learning methods to improve training effectiveness and students’ learning experience.
  • Develop eLearning strategy for technical training delivery and build up eLearning capability of the team, e.g., webinars, video, self-paced or on-demand learning methods.
  • Leverage Learning Management System (LMS) to house, deploy and track global training initiatives to include certification programs.
  • Drive continuous improvement projects to improve training quality and effectiveness.
  • Develop and maintain a process to keep track of training records and ensure compliance with internal and external audits.
  • Improve training compliance with all safety, quality, and regulatory requirements.
  • Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.
    • Can explain and demonstrate in clear understanding manner the operation / show the procedures to the operator.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5 To 7 years of experience managing people.
  • 2+ years’ experience with Data Center related architecture, electrical and thermal systems, safety and security and all related procedures.
  • Good time management skills, public speaking skills, problem-solving skills and both verbal and written communication skills
  • Proficiency in word processing and presentation software
  • Ability to operate media equipment such as projectors and personal computers
  • Knowledge about traditional and modern training methods and techniques
  • Exceptional organization skills, leadership, and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work with a team and have attention to detail
  • Knowledgeable about learning management systems, instructional design and e-learning platforms
  • Ability to handle multiple assignments and assess and analyze data
  • Ability to evaluate needs and present effective learning and performance solutions.
  • Level of communication skills (both oral and written) and interpersonal skills to effectively interact with all levels of associates on various subject matters and to convey knowledge and ideas in a logical, interesting, and engaging manner to others.
  • Level of analytical ability is required to find solutions to difficult human, technical and administrative problems.
  • Ability to motivate, influence and coach individuals who do not have a direct reporting relationship to you.
  • Experience in public speaking, oral presentations, and delivering technical content in an engaging manner.
  • Learning Management System experience, survey software, MS suite (PPT, Project, Word, Excel)
  • Knowledge of proven training approaches, as well as the technology to support training.
  • Experience designing technical lab environments to support the delivery of Power, Thermal and data center technology topics.
  • Experience partnering with senior leadership to build and drive compelling strategies, be it Training or operational, to align with business objectives, and growth needs.
  • Experience in the engagement and management of Subject Matter Experts to support an effective training delivery model
  • Experience with Learning & Development, specifically learning architecture and systems, learner development frameworks, instructional and learning methodologies
  • Familiarity with learning tools that enhance blended learning experiences
  • Experience with IT best practice frameworks (ITIL, LEAN, Oracle) and Operational Excellence concepts or methodologies.

MetLife established a Global capability center (MGCC) in India to scale and mature Data & Analytics, technology and operations capabilities in a cost-effective manner and make MetLife future ready. The center is integral to Global Technology and Operations with a focus to protect & build MetLife IP, promote reusability and drive experimentation and innovation. Data Quality Analyst plays a critical role in data and analytics life cycle and significantly contributes to ensuring data quality of production grade data and analytics solutions. The role requires one to demonstrate expertise in data profiling, validation, data pipeline monitoring and quality reporting.This role mentors Data Quality Analysts. It is an individual contributor role, expected to solve wide ranging business problems, It is an individual contributor role.

  • Perform DQ checks at various lifecycle stages e.g. (unit testing , intergration testing, user acceptance testing)
  • Perform profiling to detect anomalies
  • Create and maintain data quality artefacts
  • Collaborate with multiple partners from Business, Technology, Operations and D&A capabilities (Data Governance, BSA, Data science, Data Platforms, BI)
  • Independently lead design, solutioning & estimations
  • Mentor DQ Analysts
  • Collaborate with multiple partners from Business,Technology, Operations and D&A capabilities (Data Governance, Data Quality, Data Modeling, Data Architecture, Data science, DevOps, BI & insights)

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

Education


Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology or equivalent educational qualification


Technical Skills and Experience

  • 8-10+ years of relevant experience
  • SQL
  • Azure Data Services (data factory,synpase)
  • Data quality testing tools such as Atacamma(web & Desktop), IDQ, ETL tools like Tosca
  • Data profiling, cleansing and anomaly techniques
  • Understand Datamart, Data lake and Data Warehouse
  • Mentorship experience
  • Experience working with large data states in On-Prem and Cloud environments
  • Communication skills, analytical skills, structured problem-solving skills

Good to Have (Preferred)

  • NO-SQL databases, HIVE

Ensure reliable finance master data across global systems

Are you interested in financial master data, SAP S/4HANA and data governance in an international finance environment? As Master Data Analyst Finance, you will help ensure accurate, consistent and governed financial data across ERP, reporting and analytics platforms. This is an opportunity to support reliable financial reporting, controlling, compliance and decision-making while contributing to NKT’s green transition in a global company.

Manage finance data quality, governance and reporting

In this role, you will support the Master Data Management team, Finance, Controlling, GPOs and business data owners by maintaining financial master data across objects such as Chart of Accounts, Cost Centers, Profit Centers, GL accounts and Business Partner finance attributes. You will work with data profiling, cleansing, governance controls, dashboards and SAP S/4HANA-related activities.

Your responsibility will be to:

  • Maintain and validate financial master data in ERP systems according to governance processes
  • Support data definitions, hierarchies, business rules and finance data standards
  • Analyse data quality issues and support cleansing, migration and enrichment activities
  • Create reports, dashboards and visualisations for finance master data KPIs
  • Collaborate with Finance, Controlling, GPOs, data owners and the MDM team

The position is based in Chennai, reporting to Senior Director, Head of Process Excellence & Master Data.

Detail-oriented finance data professional with global mindset

You approach tasks in a structured and accurate way, with curiosity for solving data-related challenges. You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical colleagues and are comfortable turning complex information into practical insights. You enjoy working across teams and countries, building constructive working relationships and supporting shared outcomes in an international environment.

You also have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science or related field
  • Experience as a Data Analyst or Master Data Analyst within finance or controlling
  • Knowledge of Chart of Accounts, Cost Centers, Profit Centers and Business Partner finance data
  • Practical experience with SAP ECC or SAP S/4HANA financial master data
  • Skills in Power BI, SQL, Qlik, Python and Microsoft Excel

Shape cleaner energy through trusted finance data

NKT is committed to developing a diverse organization and culture where people of diverse backgrounds can grow and are inspired to do their best. We are committed to establishing gender diversity at NKT and encouraging all interested candidates to apply – even if you don’t tick all the boxes described. We believe that a diverse organization enables long-term performance, and that an inclusive and welcoming culture creates a better work environment.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to grow your skills in financial data governance, SAP S/4HANA, reporting and analytics while working with colleagues across functions and countries. You will be part of a collaborative team supporting global process management, master data quality and finance transformation in an international setting.

"As a leader, I value people who combine accuracy, curiosity and collaboration. This role is important for creating reliable finance data foundations that support reporting, compliance and better decisions across our global organisation," says Hiring Manager, Maria Vestergaard Jensen.

Read more about our offer and listen to some voices of NKT Connectors here!

Are you interested in financial master data, SAP S/4HANA and data governance in an international finance environment? As Master Data Analyst Finance, you will help ensure accurate, consistent and governed financial data across ERP, reporting and analytics platforms. This is an opportunity to support reliable financial reporting, controlling, compliance and decision-making while contributing to NKT’s green transition in a global company.
Manage finance data quality, governance and reporting
In this role, you will support the Master Data Management team, Finance, Controlling, GPOs and business data owners by maintaining financial master data across objects such as Chart of Accounts, Cost Centers, Profit Centers, GL accounts and Business Partner finance attributes. You will work with data profiling, cleansing, governance controls, dashboards and SAP S/4HANA-related activities.
Your responsibility will be to:
Maintain and validate financial master data in ERP systems according to governance processes
Support data definitions, hierarchies, business rules and finance data standards
Analyse data quality issues and support cleansing, migration and enrichment activities
Create reports, dashboards and visualisations for finance master data KPIs
Collaborate with Finance, Controlling, GPOs, data owners and the MDM team
The position is based in Chennai, reporting to Senior Director, Head of Process Excellence & Master Data.
Detail-oriented finance data professional with global mindset
You approach tasks in a structured and accurate way, with curiosity for solving data-related challenges. You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical colleagues and are comfortable turning complex information into practical insights. You enjoy working across teams and countries, building constructive working relationships and supporting shared outcomes in an international environment.
You also have:
Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science or related field
Experience as a Data Analyst or Master Data Analyst within finance or controlling
Knowledge of Chart of Accounts, Cost Centers, Profit Centers and Business Partner finance data
Practical experience with SAP ECC or SAP S/4HANA financial master data
Skills in Power BI, SQL, Qlik, Python and Microsoft Excel
Shape cleaner energy through trusted finance data
NKT is committed to developing a diverse organization and culture where people of diverse backgrounds can grow and are inspired to do their best. We are committed to establishing gender diversity at NKT and encouraging all interested candidates to apply – even if you don’t tick all the boxes described. We believe that a diverse organization enables long-term performance, and that an inclusive and welcoming culture creates a better work environment.
In this role, you will have the opportunity to grow your skills in financial data governance, SAP S/4HANA, reporting and analytics while working with colleagues across functions and countries. You will be part of a collaborative team supporting global process management, master data quality and finance transformation in an international setting.
"As a leader, I value people who combine accuracy, curiosity and collaboration. This role is important for creating reliable finance data foundations that support reporting, compliance and better decisions across our global organisation," says Hiring Manager, Maria Vestergaard Jensen.
Read more about our offer and listen to some voices of NKT Connectors here!
We will review applications continuously, but we recommend you apply no later than 31st July 2026. Be aware that personality and cognitive tests might be included in the recruitment process. Please note that due to the GDPR regulations we cannot accept any applications via e-mail.
We collect confidential candidate experience feedback to improve our recruitment process. Your responses are for quality development only and do not affect hiring decisions.
Be a Connector of the green tomorrow!
#LI-GV1
About NKT
NKT connects a greener world with high-quality power cable technology and takes centre stage as the world moves towards green energy. NKT designs, manufactures and installs low-, medium- and high-voltage power cable solutions enabling sustainable energy transmission. Since 1891, NKT has innovated the power cable technology building the infrastructure for the first light bulbs to the megawatts created by renewable energy today. NKT is headquartered in Denmark and employs 6,500 people. NKT is listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen and realised a revenue of EUR 3.6 billion in 2025. We connect a greener world. www.nkt.com

Clinical Data Analyst & Scientific Writer

Company: Prolife Cancer Centre
Location: Gultekdi (Market Yard), Pune
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Job Summary

Prolife Cancer Centre is seeking a skilled Clinical Data Analyst & Scientific Writer to join our research team. The selected candidate will work with a large oncology database of over 4,000 patient records, performing clinical data analysis, survival analysis, and scientific manuscript preparation for publication in peer-reviewed international journals.

Key Responsibilities

  • Extract, clean, and organize oncology patient data from hospital records and electronic medical records (EMRs).
  • Perform statistical analyses, including survival analysis and clinical outcome assessment.
  • Prepare scientific manuscripts for submission to peer-reviewed journals.
  • Write and compile the Methods and Results sections of research papers.
  • Manage references and ensure manuscripts comply with journal submission guidelines.
  • Collaborate with clinicians and researchers on ongoing research projects.
  • Maintain accurate research databases and documentation.

Eligibility

  • 1-3 + years of relevant experience in clinical research, biostatistics, scientific writing, or medical data analysis.
  • Educational qualifications may include:
  • BAMS, BHMS, or BUMS with postgraduate training in Clinical Research, Biostatistics, or Public Health.
  • M.Sc. or Ph.D. in Statistics or Biostatistics.
  • M.Sc., M.Tech, or Ph.D. in Bioinformatics, Biotechnology, Clinical Research, Life Sciences, or related disciplines.

Skills Required

  • Proficiency in R, SAS, or SPSS for statistical analysis.
  • Experience with clinical data management and electronic medical records (EMRs).
  • Strong understanding of survival analysis, including Kaplan-Meier analysis, Log-rank tests, and Cox Proportional Hazards models.
  • Familiarity with oncology concepts such as TNM Staging, Progression-Free Survival (PFS), and Overall Survival (OS).
  • Experience with scientific writing and manuscript preparation.
  • Knowledge of reference management tools such as EndNote or Mendeley.
  • Excellent analytical, organizational, and written communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • At least 2–3 publications in PubMed- or Scopus-indexed journals as a primary author or lead analyst.
  • Experience working with oncology research data and clinical publications.

Salary

Competitive salary, based on experience, qualifications, and interview performance.

Work Location: Gultekdi (Market Yard), Pune
Joining: Immediate

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

QA Engineer / Business Analyst

Department: Product Development

Role Overview

This is a unique hybrid role that combines the analytical capabilities of a Business Analyst with the quality-driven mindset of a QA Engineer.

The successful candidate will work closely with Product Manager, Developers, Data Teams, and Business Stakeholders to understand business requirements, define functional specifications, validate solutions, and ensure the successful delivery of reliable, scalable, and user-friendly products.

Key ResponsibilitiesQuality Assurance & Testing

· Design and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scenarios based on business and functional requirements.

· Perform manual testing across web applications, APIs, data platforms, and SaaS products.

· Conduct functional, integration, regression, system, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

· Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects through to resolution.

· Collaborate with development teams to investigate issues, validate fixes, and ensure product quality.

· Participate in sprint planning, sprint reviews, and release activities to embed quality throughout the development lifecycle.

· Maintain test documentation and contribute to the continuous improvement of QA processes and standards.

Automation Testing

· Develop, maintain, and enhance automated test scripts and testing frameworks.

· Automate repetitive functional and regression test scenarios to improve testing efficiency and coverage.

· Execute and monitor automated test suites as part of the release and deployment process.

· Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines to support continuous delivery.

· Utilize modern automation tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or equivalent frameworks.

· Continuously improve automation coverage, reliability, and effectiveness.

Business Analysis

· Engage with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document requirements.

· Facilitate requirement-gathering sessions, workshops, and stakeholder discussions.

· Prepare and maintain:

o Business Requirement Documents (BRDs)

o Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs)

o User Stories

o Use Cases

o Process Flows

o Acceptance Criteria

· Translate business needs into clear and actionable functional specifications for development teams.

· Support requirement validation and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities.

· Act as a liaison between business users and technology teams to ensure successful project delivery.

Data Analysis & Business Insights

· Analyze large datasets to identify trends, patterns, business opportunities, and potential risks.

· Generate actionable insights to support product strategy, sales initiatives, operational improvements, and business growth.

· Define, monitor, and report on key business metrics and KPIs.

· Conduct ad-hoc analysis and root cause investigations to support decision-making.

· Present findings, recommendations, and insights to stakeholders in a clear and meaningful manner.

· Support strategic initiatives through data-driven analysis and reporting.

Data Validation & SQL Analysis

· Validate large datasets and ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across systems.

· Write complex SQL queries for testing, reporting validation, and data verification.

· Perform data reconciliation, audit checks, and quality assurance activities.

· Investigate and troubleshoot data-related issues in collaboration with engineering and data teams.

· Validate dashboards, reports, APIs, analytics outputs, and business intelligence solutions.

Technical Skills & Competencies

QA & Testing

· Understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC).

· Hands-on experience with manual testing methodologies and best practices.

· Experience in functional, integration, regression, API, system, and UAT testing.

· Strong defect management, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis skills.

· Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

Automation Testing

Hands-on experience with one or more of the following:

· Selenium

· Playwright

· Cypress

· TestNG / JUnit

· Other modern automation frameworks

Experience in:

· Designing and maintaining automation frameworks

· Web and API test automation

· CI/CD integration and automated release validation

SQL & Data Validation

Strong expertise in SQL, including:

· Complex joins

· Subqueries

· Aggregations

· Window functions

· Stored procedures

· Query optimization

· Data reconciliation and validation

Experience with:

· MySQL

· PostgreSQL

· Microsoft SQL Server

API Testing:

· Postman

· Swagger / OpenAPI

· REST APIs

· JSON validation and troubleshooting

Tools & Platforms:

· Jira

· Git

· Test Management Tools

· CI/CD tools (preferred)

Preferred Skills:

· Experience working with SaaS products and enterprise applications.

· Exposure to Construction Technology Infrastructure Technology, or Data Analytics platforms.

· Understanding of Business Intelligence (BI) and Data Analytics solutions.

· Exposure to AWS or other cloud platforms.

· Basic understanding of ETL processes and data pipelines.

· Familiarity with Python or similar scripting languages for automation and data validation.

· Experience working with data-intensive applications, reporting platforms, and analytics solutions.

Qualifications:

· Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.

· Relevant certifications such as ISTQB, Agile, Business Analysis, Automation Testing, or equivalent certifications will be considered an advantage.

Experience:

· 3–5 years of experience in Quality Assurance, Business Analysis, or a hybrid QA-Business Analyst role.

· Proven experience working with software product companies, SaaS platforms, or data-driven applications.

· Prior experience in Construction Technology, Data Analytics, Market Intelligence, or B2B SaaS platforms will be highly preferred.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Our Company:


At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

What You’ll Do

In this role, you will serve as the product owner and primary business systems analyst for the Certinia PSA platform supporting Teradata’s Global Consulting organization. You will act as the critical link between business stakeholders and the technical development team — translating complex operational needs into clear, actionable requirements that drive meaningful improvements to how our consulting teams work.

  • Manage the Certinia PSA product backlog, prioritizing features and enhancements in alignment with business strategy and stakeholder needs.
  • Gather, document, and refine business requirements through structured stakeholder engagement, translating them into user stories and functional specifications for the development team.
  • Support sprint planning, backlog grooming, and sprint review ceremonies in collaboration with development and QA resources.
  • Develop and execute test plans for new features and system changes, coordinating user acceptance testing (UAT) with business stakeholders.
  • Communicate roadmaps, release plans, and system change impacts clearly and proactively to stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
  • Partner with the Global Consulting leadership to identify process improvement opportunities and ensure the PSA platform continues to evolve with business needs.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for Certinia PSA, providing guidance on system capabilities, best practices, and configuration options.
  • Investigate and resolve Tier 2 production issues related to FinancialForce (Certinia) or Salesforce.

Commercial Finance Analyst

Location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates

Department: Commercial Finance

Reports to: Head of Commercial Finance

Employment type: Full-time

Role Overview

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with commercial and sales teams to build, challenge and refine budgets, forecasts and business cases.
  • Prepare monthly management reporting, including variance analysis of revenue, gross margin and operating costs against budget and forecast.
  • Develop and maintain financial models to support pricing, customer profitability and investment decisions.
  • Analyse sales performance by event, customer and region, and clearly communicate the drivers behind the numbers.
  • Support the annual budgeting and quarterly reforecasting cycles, consolidating inputs from across the business.
  • Track and report on key commercial KPIs, identifying risks, opportunities and corrective actions.
  • Evaluate capital expenditure and new business proposals, providing ROI, payback and sensitivity analysis.
  • Identify and lead opportunities to automate manual reporting and processes, using tools such as Power Query, Python or AI-driven assistants to improve speed, accuracy and data quality.
  • Champion the adoption of new data, analytics and AI tools within the Commercial Finance team, building dashboards and self-service reporting that put insight directly in the hands of the business.
  • Ensure compliance with internal controls, company policies and applicable UAE financial regulations.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or a related discipline.
  • Professional qualification (or active progression towards) such as ACCA, CIMA, CFA or CPA is strongly preferred.
  • 3–5 years of relevant experience in financial analysis, FP&A or commercial finance, ideally within a fast-paced commercial environment.
  • Demonstrable experience business-partnering with non-finance stakeholders.
  • Prior experience in the UAE or wider GCC region is an advantage.

Skills & Competencies

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including financial modelling; proficiency with ERP systems (e.g. SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics).
  • Strong analytical capability with the ability to translate complex data into clear, concise recommendations.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with confidence presenting to senior leadership.
  • Experience with BI and visualisation tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau) is desirable.
  • A genuine passion for AI, automation and data, with curiosity about emerging tools (e.g. generative AI assistants, Python, SQL, Power Query) and how they can transform finance.
  • Commercial acumen, attention to detail and a proactive, solutions-oriented mindset.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a dynamic environment.

Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together.


Technical Product Manager - RCM (Revenue Cycle Management) Common Data Platform


The Technical Product Manager (TPM) - RCM Common Data Platform drives the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of building out a unified data platform across the full Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) lifecycle. The solution will ultimately ingest disparate EHR and healthcare data sources, standardize them and normalize them into single source of truth. This individual will work alongside members from across Optum to solve complex business needs for our internal operations teams. The role is key to execution on critical use cases to understand the data, ingest data, unify disparate data and drive AI powered insights. The ideal candidate for this role must be passionate about how we can leverage data to drive improvements in our RCM Operations, effective at working in a fast-paced, high-energy environment and confident in their interactions with senior leaders. The TPM RCM Common Data Platform role combines deep technical product expertise with solid RCM data knowledge to deliver scalable, compliant, AI powered insights that reduce administrative burden, improves performance, accelerates throughput, and strengthen financial outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities:

  • Drive Product Strategy & Product Execution for CDP Data
    • Leads the data strategy across one-to-multiple CDP workstreams including (but not limited to) Longitudinal Account Record, Ambulatory Insights and AI Powered RCM Insights
    • Leads product team members in translating desired capabilities into product requirements specifications and/or operational AI powered enhancements - serving as the data expert to drive product and engineering to complete CDP build as outlined in projected roadmap
    • Understands the planned architecture of CDP, how it is being utilized to meet business/operational needs
    • Strategically aligns with Commercial team on Common Data Platform - along with how the data will be utilized from the platform
    • Strategically aligns with teams infusing data into Common Data Platform - along with how the data will be utilized from the platform
  • Technical Product Leadership & Architecture Alignment
    • Leads technical product design for CDP data, ensuring alignment with engineering and architecture standards
    • Partners with engineering to identify and drive improvements in data ingestion, labeling, interoperability, and integration across RCM ecosystem
    • Balances rapid delivery needs with scalable architecture and long‑term platform health
  • Agile Execution & Operational Excellence
    • Leads agile product practices across engineering and data architecture teams to ensure predictable, high‑quality delivery of new capabilities
    • Maintains a rigorous Definition of Done
    • Partners with delivery leadership to manage team capacity, predictability of sprints, and cross‑team dependencies for deployment
  • Cross‑Functional Collaboration & Influence
    • Leads multi-year Customer deployment plans for CDP data - creation, internal alignment, customer reviews & evolution
    • Serves as chief data expert across teams to internally align people, process and technology while helping drive CDP adoption
    • Coordinates with Product Operations and Engineering on rollout strategy for existing customers
    • Works across the matrix to define, evolve, and support release of specific data related capabilities and functions across customers
  • Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regard to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field (Information Technology, Computer Science, Health Information Management, Product Management, Analytics)
  • 8+ years in healthcare services, healthcare technology or software development
  • 6+ years in product management or technical product roles with specific experience in data platforms
  • 3+ years in technical product leadership across large, matrixed initiatives integrating engineering, data architects, RCM operations, and clinical stakeholders
  • Hands‑on experience with RCM data within US healthcare
  • Hands-on experience with data platforms and business intelligence related technologies including Databricks, Power BI, Tableau, etc.
  • Key Skills:
    • Experience driving data platform product roadmaps, prioritization frameworks, and large‑scale cross‑functional initiatives
    • Deep domain expertise in revenue cycle data and related applications
    • Solid understanding of data warehouse concepts and their application to RCM
    • Ability to interpret and evaluate RCM data as well as how to unify disparate data sources
    • Solid technical acumen in RCM data structures and associated applications


At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone - of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income - deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.

Position Summary:
If you are an export-import (EXIM) and trade compliance professional looking to grow your career, Emerson offers an exciting opportunity to make an impact. In this role, you will manage export licensing, import compliance, and special shipment processes while ensuring adherence to global trade regulations. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, government authorities, and external partners to enable smooth international trade operations and drive process improvements across the supply chain.
In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:
  • Manage export licenses, including applications, tracking, utilization, and compliance with applicable regulations and policies.
  • Coordinate with government authorities for license issuance, amendments, and clarifications.
  • Handle import compliance activities, resolving customs-related queries and ensuring adherence to applicable trade regulations and policies.
  • Prepare and submit required statutory documents and reports to regulatory authorities.
  • Manage special shipment processes such as re-import, re-export, and capital goods imports, ensuring proper documentation and compliance.
  • Coordinate with suppliers, freight forwarders, and customs stakeholders to ensure timely and accurate shipment execution.
  • Maintain accurate records of licenses, shipping documentation, and regulatory correspondence.
  • Prepare and share periodic reports on license utilization, shipment status, and compliance metrics.
  • Collaborate with finance, procurement, and sales teams to ensure alignment of data and documentation.
  • Identify opportunities to improve EXIM processes, enhance efficiency, and strengthen compliance practices.
  • Stay up to date with evolving trade regulations, customs requirements, and licensing frameworks.
Who You Are:
You take decisive action in complex and evolving situations, using your expertise to ensure compliance and operational continuity. You actively seek input from relevant stakeholders to make well-informed decisions and resolve challenges effectively. You communicate clearly and collaborate across teams to ensure alignment and timely execution. You continuously look for opportunities to improve processes and adapt to changing regulatory environments.
For This Role, You Will Need:
  • A bachelor’s degree in commerce, business administration, logistics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience in export-import operations, trade compliance, or logistics within a manufacturing or international trade environment.
  • Strong knowledge of trade regulations, licensing processes, and customs compliance requirements.
  • Experience working with regulatory portals and managing export/import documentation.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  • Effective communication and coordination skills to work with cross-functional and external stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:
  • Hands-on experience with government licensing systems and customs procedures.
  • Familiarity with enterprise systems such as Oracle or similar ERP platforms.
  • Knowledge of data analysis or reporting tools (e.g., Excel, Power BI, or similar).
  • Experience managing complex shipments such as capital goods, re-import, or re-export.
  • Strong documentation and reporting capabilities.
Our Culture and Commitment To You:
At Emerson, we foster a workplace where every individual is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We believe innovation thrives through collaboration and diverse perspectives, and we are committed to supporting your development through mentorship, learning opportunities, and global exposure.
We prioritize employee wellbeing by offering competitive compensation, comprehensive medical benefits, employee assistance programs, and flexible time-off policies, including parental leave. Our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion ensures a welcoming environment where everyone can succeed and make a meaningful impact.

WHY EMERSON

Our Commitment to Our People

At Emerson, we are motivated by a spirit of collaboration that helps our diverse, multicultural teams across the world drive innovation that makes the world healthier, safer, smarter, and more sustainable. And we want you to join us in our bold aspiration.

We have built an engaged community of inquisitive, dedicated people who thrive knowing they are welcomed, trusted, celebrated, and empowered to solve the world’s most complex problems — for our customers, our communities, and the planet. You’ll contribute to this vital work while further developing your skills through our award-winning employee development programs. We are a proud corporate citizen in every city where we operate and are committed to our people, our communities, and the world at large. We take this responsibility seriously and strive to make a positive impact through every endeavor.

At Emerson, you’ll see firsthand that our people are at the center of everything we do. So, let’s go. Let’s think differently. Learn, collaborate, and grow. Seek opportunity. Push boundaries. Be empowered to make things better. Speed up to break through. Let’s go, together.

Accessibility Assistance or Accommodation

If you have a disability and are having difficulty accessing or using this website to apply for a position, please contact: idisability.administrator@emerson.com .

ABOUT EMERSON

Emerson is a global leader in automation technology and software. Through our deep domain expertise and legacy of flawless execution, Emerson helps customers in critical industries like life sciences, energy, power and renewables, chemical and advanced factory automation operate more sustainably while improving productivity, energy security and reliability.

With global operations and a comprehensive portfolio of software and technology, we are helping companies implement digital transformation to measurably improve their operations, conserve valuable resources and enhance their safety.

We offer equitable opportunities, celebrate diversity, and embrace challenges with confidence that, together, we can make an impact across a broad spectrum of countries and industries. Whether you’re an established professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring possibilities, or a recent graduate with an advanced degree, you’ll find your chance to make a difference with Emerson. Some careers open more doors than others.

If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

Business Descriptor

Contact Centre Business plays a central role in maintaining our reputation as a leader in banking in Hong Kong. It serves as a vital channel in ensuring successful business development while addressing customers’ different financial needs and delivering quality banking service to our millions of customers through multiple touchpoints including inbound and outbound calling activities. The value of Contact Centre Business continues to grow as it cultivates collaboration and improved financial services provision across a broad range of our business areas.

Role Purpose

Handles general customer contacts in a contact centre environment typically on a Multiple products and or proposition. Provides high quality service to achieve maximum customer satisfaction by ensuring the completion of VCIP journey at first contact, where possible. Takes ownership and initiative to complete steps involved for resolution. Responsible for achieving individual key performance indicators whilst maintaining quality and compliance.

Principal Accountabilities

Impact on the Business

  • Video KYC enable customers to submit their KYC information through a video call from any place of their convenience ensuring compliance, faster on-boarding and minimize time to revenue.
  • Video KYC facilitates in improving the customer experience while saving on KYC cost.

Customers / Stakeholders

  • Provides excellent customer service to customers by face to face interaction with trained official to expedite the KYC process.

Leadership & Teamwork

  • Acts as a role model for our Group Values and Behaviours (Open, Connected, Dependable), supporting colleagues and customers to deliver superior customer service through these values
  • Values diversity amongst team

Operational Effectiveness & Control

  • Maintains HSBC internal control standards
  • Complete all mandatory and recommended LMS modules on time
  • Comply to all relevant AML regulations & Global Standards
  • Performing Customer Due Diligence as per the laid down guidelines in SOP.

Major Challenges

  • Changing performance parameters (e.g. Scorecard changes)
  • Understanding updates on procedural changes and compliance
  • Achieving customer excellence in every contact

Role Context

  • The role operates within a WPB and interacts with HSBC local customers, the post holder must have the ability to deal with different process, where applicable

Management of Risk

  • Maintain awareness of operational risk and minimize the likelihood of it occurring including its identification, assessment, mitigation and control, loss identification and reporting in accordance with section 4 of the Group Operations FIM.

Observation of Internal Controls

  • Maintains HSBC internal control standards and addresses audit points and/or any issues raised by regulators in a timely manner.
  • Fosters a compliance culture within the team, managing compliance risk and ensuring that the necessary training is completed.
  • Optimizes relations with regulators.

Role Dimensions

  • The role is not authorized for any approvals outside of system allotted entitlements

Qualifications

  • Minimum Graduation or as required for the role, whichever is higher
  • Must be proficient language(s) required by the process
  • Open to working flexible shifting schedules
  • Must be flexible, customer centric and have the ability to thrive in a team environment seeking feedback and open to development
  • Takes pride in delivering what is promised in line with the customer and service expectations
  • Wants to do a good job, is concerned about getting it right for the customer and checks everything is in order
  • Ability to work in a high-volume, fast paced environment is required
  • Proficiency with personal computers and basic software packages and specialised applications
  • Excellent communication skills and is polite and friendly at all times
  • Displays patience and empathy
  • Pro-tip : Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.


You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Position: Research Analyst – Delhi

Location: Delhi
Role Type: Full-Time, In-office
Experience: 2-6 Years

Company Description

Pragyan Impact Solutions is dedicated to transforming ambitious goals into measurable outcomes by collaborating with governments, nonprofits, communities, and institutions across India. As a team of experienced practitioners, we specialize in addressing complex governance and development challenges with evidence-based insights, human-centered design, and collaborative execution. Offering a range of services from strategic advisory and program design to technology-driven execution and capacity building, Pragyan Impact Solutions is committed to reshaping governance and improving social outcomes for sustainable socio-economic growth.

About the Role

We are looking for curious, analytical, and driven Research Analysts to join our consulting team. The role involves conducting high-quality research, generating actionable insights, and supporting strategic projects across governance, public policy, development, and corporate sectors.

We are hiring candidates from three different research backgrounds, depending on their expertise and interest:

1. Research Analyst – Engineering & Technology

Ideal for candidates with an Engineering or Technology background who enjoy data-driven research, analytics, emerging technologies, AI, digital transformation, and innovation.

2. Research Analyst – Business, Economics & Public Policy

Suitable for candidates with backgrounds in Business, Economics, Public Policy, Social Sciences, or Management, with experience in market research, policy analysis, governance, strategy, or consulting.

3. Research Analyst – Journalism & Narrative Research

Ideal for candidates from Journalism, Mass Communication, Media Studies, English, or related disciplines who possess strong writing, storytelling, qualitative research, content analysis, and narrative-building skills for reports, knowledge products, and strategic communication.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct primary and secondary research using credible national and international sources.
  • Gather, validate, analyze, and synthesize qualitative and quantitative data.
  • Prepare literature reviews, policy briefs, research reports, presentations, and knowledge products.
  • Perform industry analysis, market assessments, benchmarking, and trend analysis.
  • Translate complex research findings into clear, actionable insights and strategic recommendations.
  • Develop client-ready presentations and reports with high accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support consulting assignments, proposals, and project delivery.
  • Track emerging trends, innovations, government initiatives, and sector developments.
  • Maintain high standards of research quality, documentation, and data integrity.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Economics, Public Policy, Social Sciences, Journalism, Mass Communication, English, Statistics, Data Science, or related disciplines.
  • Master's degree is preferred.

Desired Skills

  • Strong analytical and critical thinking abilities.
  • Excellent research and information synthesis skills.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
  • Familiarity with Power BI, Python, SPSS, Tableau, or other analytical tools is an added advantage.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple assignments simultaneously.
  • Strong attention to detail with a structured problem-solving approach.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced consulting environment and meet tight deadlines.

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹80,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):

  • Current CTC in LPA
  • Expected CTC in LPA

Work Location: In person

  • Cloud Data Pipelines: Collaborate closely with Data Engineering teams to extract data from cloud environments and build robust, scalable data pipelines using Snowflake, DBT and GitHub

  • Graduate in Engineering/Sciences/Statistics , MBA

  • Experience with third-party data i.e. syndicated market data (Nielsen, Kantar, IRI) Point of Sales, Ecommerce data etc.

  • Ability to Read , Analyze and Visualize data

  • Effective Verbal & Written Communication for Business engagement

  • Excellent presentation/visualization skills

  • Created/worked on automated Insights solution

  • Worked on Competition Intelligence solutions

  • Willingness and ability to experiment with new tools and techniques
